theorem activeAx0_unowned (u : Wire 304) (hact : ActiveAx0Prop u.val)
    (hown : isDaddaOwned u.val = false) (hu49 : u.val ≠ 49) :
    (f304ToAx0 u).val < 8 ∨ f304ToAx0 u = ⟨9, by decide⟩ := by
  have hchk : ((List.finRange 304).all fun w ↦
      !(okW304_Ax0 w.val) || isDaddaOwned w.val || (w.val == 49) ||
      Nat.blt (f304ToAx0 w).val 8 || (f304ToAx0 w == ⟨9, by decide⟩)) = true := by decide +kernel
  have hw :=
      (List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) u (List.mem_finRange u); rw [okW304_Ax0_of_active hact, hown,
      beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hu49] at hw; simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_eq_true,
      Nat.blt_eq, beq_iff_eq] at hw; exact hw
def maskWords (msk : ℕ) : List ℕ → List ℕ
  | [] => []
  | w :: ws => (w &&& msk) :: maskWords msk ws

theorem evalWords_maskWords (msk : ℕ) :
    ∀ (ws : List ℕ) (m : ℕ), msk.testBit m = true →
      evalWords (maskWords msk ws) m = evalWords ws m
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | w :: ws, m, hm => by
      dsimp only [maskWords, evalWords];
      rw [Nat.testBit_and, hm, Bool.and_true, evalWords_maskWords msk ws m hm]
def maskNot255 : ℕ :=
    ((0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff <<< 384) ||| (0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff <<<
    256) ||| (0x7fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff <<< 128) ||| 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff)
theorem maskNot255_false_imp (m : Fin 512) (h : maskNot255.testBit m.val = false) :
    m = ⟨255, by decide⟩ := by
  have hchk : ((List.finRange 512).all fun k ↦
      maskNot255.testBit k.val || (k == ⟨255, by decide⟩)) = true := by decide +kernel
  have hk :=
      (List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) m (List.mem_finRange m); rw [h,
      Bool.false_or] at hk; exact beq_iff_eq.mp hk
theorem maskNot255_true_of_ne (m : Fin 512) (hm : m ≠ ⟨255, by decide⟩) :
    maskNot255.testBit m.val = true := by
  cases h : maskNot255.testBit m.val
  · exact False.elim (hm (maskNot255_false_imp m h))
  · rfl

abbrev ActiveAx2ShaProp (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
    n = 40 ∨ n = 41 ∨ n = 42 ∨ n = 43 ∨ n = 44 ∨ n = 45 ∨ n = 46 ∨ n = 47 ∨ n = 49 ∨ n = 75 ∨ n =
    76 ∨ n = 78 ∨ n = 100 ∨ n = 101 ∨ n = 102 ∨ n = 103 ∨ n = 104 ∨ n = 105 ∨ n = 106 ∨ n = 107 ∨
    n = 108 ∨ n = 109 ∨ n = 110 ∨ n = 111 ∨ n = 112 ∨ n = 113 ∨ n = 114 ∨ n = 115 ∨ n = 116 ∨ n =
    117

def okW304_Ax2Sha (n : ℕ) : Bool :=
    (n == 40) || (n == 41) || (n == 42) || (n == 43) || (n == 44) || (n == 45) || (n == 46) ||
    (n == 47) || (n == 49) || (n == 75) || (n == 76) || (n == 78) || (n == 100) || (n == 101) ||
    (n == 102) || (n == 103) || (n == 104) || (n == 105) || (n == 106) || (n == 107) ||
    (n == 108) || (n == 109) || (n == 110) || (n == 111) || (n == 112) || (n == 113) ||
    (n == 114) || (n == 115) || (n == 116) || (n == 117)

def fAx2ShaTo304 (u : Wire 30) : Wire 304 :=
    if u.val = 0 then w304 40 else if u.val = 1 then w304 41 else if u.val =
    2 then w304 42 else if u.val = 3 then w304 43 else if u.val = 4 then w304 44 else if u.val =
    5 then w304 45 else if u.val = 6 then w304 46 else if u.val = 7 then w304 47 else if u.val =
    8 then w304 49 else if u.val = 9 then w304 75 else if u.val = 10 then w304 76 else if u.val =
    11 then w304 78 else if u.val = 12 then w304 100 else if u.val =
    13 then w304 101 else if u.val = 14 then w304 102 else if u.val =
    15 then w304 103 else if u.val = 16 then w304 104 else if u.val =
    17 then w304 105 else if u.val = 18 then w304 106 else if u.val =
    19 then w304 107 else if u.val = 20 then w304 108 else if u.val =
    21 then w304 109 else if u.val = 22 then w304 110 else if u.val =
    23 then w304 111 else if u.val = 24 then w304 112 else if u.val =
    25 then w304 113 else if u.val = 26 then w304 114 else if u.val =
    27 then w304 115 else if u.val = 28 then w304 116 else w304 117
def f304ToAx2Sha (w : Wire 304) : Wire 30 :=
  if _h0 : w.val = 40 then ⟨0, by decide⟩
  else if _h1 : w.val = 41 then ⟨1, by decide⟩
  else if _h2 : w.val = 42 then ⟨2, by decide⟩
  else if _h3 : w.val = 43 then ⟨3, by decide⟩
  else if _h4 : w.val = 44 then ⟨4, by decide⟩
  else if _h5 : w.val = 45 then ⟨5, by decide⟩
  else if _h6 : w.val = 46 then ⟨6, by decide⟩
  else if _h7 : w.val = 47 then ⟨7, by decide⟩
  else if _h8 : w.val = 49 then ⟨8, by decide⟩
  else if _h9 : w.val = 75 then ⟨9, by decide⟩
  else if _h10 : w.val = 76 then ⟨10, by decide⟩
  else if _h11 : w.val = 78 then ⟨11, by decide⟩
  else if _h12 : w.val = 100 then ⟨12, by decide⟩
  else if _h13 : w.val = 101 then ⟨13, by decide⟩
  else if _h14 : w.val = 102 then ⟨14, by decide⟩
  else if _h15 : w.val = 103 then ⟨15, by decide⟩
  else if _h16 : w.val = 104 then ⟨16, by decide⟩
  else if _h17 : w.val = 105 then ⟨17, by decide⟩
  else if _h18 : w.val = 106 then ⟨18, by decide⟩
  else if _h19 : w.val = 107 then ⟨19, by decide⟩
  else if _h20 : w.val = 108 then ⟨20, by decide⟩
  else if _h21 : w.val = 109 then ⟨21, by decide⟩
  else if _h22 : w.val = 110 then ⟨22, by decide⟩
  else if _h23 : w.val = 111 then ⟨23, by decide⟩
  else if _h24 : w.val = 112 then ⟨24, by decide⟩
  else if _h25 : w.val = 113 then ⟨25, by decide⟩
  else if _h26 : w.val = 114 then ⟨26, by decide⟩
  else if _h27 : w.val = 115 then ⟨27, by decide⟩
  else if _h28 : w.val = 116 then ⟨28, by decide⟩
  else if _h29 : w.val = 117 then ⟨29, by decide⟩
  else ⟨0, by decide⟩

def f304ToAx2ShaNat (s : ℕ) : ℕ :=
    if s == 40 then 0 else if s == 41 then 1 else if s == 42 then 2 else if s == 43 then 3 else if s
    == 44 then 4 else if s == 45 then 5 else if s == 46 then 6 else if s == 47 then 7 else if s ==
    49 then 8 else if s == 75 then 9 else if s == 76 then 10 else if s == 78 then 11 else if s ==
    100 then 12 else if s == 101 then 13 else if s == 102 then 14 else if s == 103 then 15 else if s
    == 104 then 16 else if s == 105 then 17 else if s == 106 then 18 else if s == 107 then 19 else
    if s == 108 then 20 else if s == 109 then 21 else if s == 110 then 22 else if s == 111 then 23
    else if s == 112 then 24 else if s == 113 then 25 else if s == 114 then 26 else if s == 115 then
    27 else if s == 116 then 28 else if s == 117 then 29 else 0

  dsimp only [okW304_Ax2Sha] at h; simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h; omega

  dsimp only [ActiveAx2ShaProp] at h; dsimp only [okW304_Ax2Sha];
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq]; omega
theorem fAx2Sha_f304_id {w : Wire 304} (hw : ActiveAx2ShaProp w.val) :
    fAx2ShaTo304 (f304ToAx2Sha w) = w := by
  have hchk : ((List.finRange 304).all fun u ↦
      !(okW304_Ax2Sha u.val) || (fAx2ShaTo304 (f304ToAx2Sha u) == u)) = true := by decide +kernel
  have hu :=
      (List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) w (List.mem_finRange w); rw [okW304_Ax2Sha_of_active hw] at hu;
      exact beq_iff_eq.mp hu
theorem f304ToAx2ShaNat_eq {s : ℕ} (hs : Nat.blt s 304 = true) : f304ToAx2ShaNat s =
    (f304ToAx2Sha (w304 s)).val := by
  have hchk : ((List.range 304).all fun n ↦
      f304ToAx2ShaNat n == (f304ToAx2Sha (w304 n)).val) = true := by decide +kernel
  exact beq_iff_eq.mp ((List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) s (List.mem_range.mpr (Nat.blt_eq.mp hs)))

theorem activeAx2Sha_iff_inForb (w : Wire 304) : inNatList w.val forbAx2ShaList = false →
    ¬ActiveAx2ShaProp w.val := by
  have hchk : ((List.range 304).all fun n ↦ okW304_Ax2Sha n == inNatList n forbAx2ShaList) =
      true := by decide +kernel
  intro hfalse hact; have hok := okW304_Ax2Sha_of_active hact;
  have heq := beq_iff_eq.mp ((List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) w.val (List.mem_range.mpr w.isLt))
  rw [hok, hfalse] at heq; exact Bool.noConfusion heq

    (hown : isDaddaOwned u.val = false) (hu49 : u.val ≠ 49) :
    (f304ToAx2Sha u).val < 8 ∨ f304ToAx2Sha u = ⟨9, by decide⟩ := by
  have hchk : ((List.finRange 304).all fun w ↦
      !(okW304_Ax2Sha w.val) || isDaddaOwned w.val || (w.val == 49) ||
      Nat.blt (f304ToAx2Sha w).val 8 || (f304ToAx2Sha w == ⟨9, by decide⟩)) =
          true := by decide +kernel
  have hw :=
      (List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) u (List.mem_finRange u); rw [okW304_Ax2Sha_of_active hact, hown,
      beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr hu49] at hw; simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or, Bool.or_eq_true,
      Nat.blt_eq, beq_iff_eq] at hw; exact hw
def activeInAx2Sha : ComputeProg 304 → Bool
  | .id => true
  | .x u => okW304_Ax2Sha u.val
  | .cnot c t _ => okW304_Ax2Sha c.val && okW304_Ax2Sha t.val
  | .andGate c1 c2 a _ _ _ => okW304_Ax2Sha c1.val && okW304_Ax2Sha c2.val && okW304_Ax2Sha a.val
  | .seq p q => activeInAx2Sha p && activeInAx2Sha q

def stepActiveAx2Sha_1 : List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))
  | [] => some []
  | .id :: rest => some rest
  | .x u :: rest => if okW304_Ax2Sha u.val then some rest else none
  | .cnot c t _ :: rest => if okW304_Ax2Sha c.val && okW304_Ax2Sha t.val then some rest else none
  | .andGate c1 c2 a _ _ _ :: rest =>
      if okW304_Ax2Sha c1.val && okW304_Ax2Sha c2.val &&
          okW304_Ax2Sha a.val then some rest else none
  | .seq p q :: rest => some (p :: q :: rest)

def stepActiveAx2ShaPow : ℕ → List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))
  | 0, ws => stepActiveAx2Sha_1 ws
  | d + 1, ws => match stepActiveAx2ShaPow d ws with
    | none => none
    | some ws' => stepActiveAx2ShaPow d ws'

def checkActiveAx2ShaPow (d : ℕ) (ws : List (ComputeProg 304)) : Bool :=
  match stepActiveAx2ShaPow d ws with
  | some [] => true
  | _ => false

theorem stepActive1_gen_sound {ok : ℕ → Bool} {act : ComputeProg 304 → Bool}
    {step1 : List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))} (ha_id : act .id = true)
    (ha_x : ∀ u, act (.x u) = ok u.val)
    (ha_cnot : ∀ c t h, act (.cnot c t h) = (ok c.val && ok t.val))
        (ha_and : ∀ c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3, act (.andGate c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3) = (ok c1.val && ok c2.val &&
        ok a.val))
    (ha_seq : ∀ p q, act (.seq p q) = (act p && act q)) (hs_id : ∀ r, step1 (.id :: r) = some r)
    (hs_x : ∀ u r, step1 (.x u :: r) = if ok u.val then some r else none)
    (hs_cnot : ∀ c t h r, step1 (.cnot c t h :: r) = if ok c.val && ok t.val then some r else none)
    (hs_and : ∀ c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3 r,
      step1 (.andGate c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3 :: r) = if ok c1.val && ok c2.val &&
          ok a.val then some r else none)
    (hs_seq : ∀ p q r, step1 (.seq p q :: r) = some (p :: q :: r)) {ws ws' : List (ComputeProg 304)}
        (h : step1 ws = some ws')
    (hall : ∀ q ∈ ws', act q = true) : ∀ q ∈ ws, act q = true := by
  have hIf {b : Bool} {p : ComputeProg 304} {r : List (ComputeProg 304)}
      (hap : act p = b) (hif : (if b then some r else none) = some ws') :
      ∀ q ∈ p :: r, act q = true := by
    cases b <;> cases hif
    exact fun q hq ↦ (List.mem_cons.mp hq).elim (· ▸ hap) (hall q)
  cases ws with
  | nil => exact fun _ hm ↦ False.elim (List.not_mem_nil hm)
  | cons p rest =>
    cases p with
    | id => exact hIf ha_id (hs_id rest ▸ h)
    | x u => exact hIf (ha_x u) (hs_x u rest ▸ h)
    | cnot c t hc => exact hIf (ha_cnot c t hc) (hs_cnot c t hc rest ▸ h)
    | andGate c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3 =>
      exact hIf (ha_and c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3) (hs_and c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3 rest ▸ h)
    | seq p1 p2 =>
      rcases Option.some.inj ((hs_seq p1 p2 rest).symm.trans h) with rfl
      exact fun q hq ↦ (List.mem_cons.mp hq).elim
        (fun e ↦ e ▸ (ha_seq p1 p2).trans (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
          ⟨hall p1 List.mem_cons_self, hall p2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩))
        fun hr ↦ hall q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr))

theorem stepActivePow_gen_sound {act : ComputeProg 304 → Bool}
    {step1 : List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))}
    {stepPow : ℕ → List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))}
    (h1 : ∀ {ws ws'}, step1 ws = some ws' → (∀ q ∈ ws', act q = true) → ∀ q ∈ ws, act q = true)
        (h0 : ∀ ws, stepPow 0 ws = step1 ws)
    (hs : ∀ d ws, stepPow (d + 1) ws =
        match stepPow d ws with | none => none | some ws' => stepPow d ws') :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) {ws ws' : List (ComputeProg 304)},
      stepPow d ws = some ws' → (∀ q ∈ ws', act q = true) → ∀ q ∈ ws, act q = true
  | 0, ws, _, h, hall => h1 ((h0 ws).symm.trans h) hall
  | d + 1, ws, _, h, hall => by
      rw [hs] at h
      cases hm : stepPow d ws <;> rw [hm] at h
      · cases h
      · exact stepActivePow_gen_sound h1 h0 hs d hm (stepActivePow_gen_sound h1 h0 hs d h
            hall)

  rcases stepPow d ws with _ | (_ | ⟨_, _⟩) <;> intro h
  · cases h
  · rfl
  · cases h

theorem ext_update_eq {K : ℕ} (P : ℕ → Prop) (fTo : Wire K → Wire 304)
    (fFrom : Wire 304 → Wire K) (bg : BitAssignment 304) (ext : BitAssignment K → BitAssignment 304)
    (hpos : ∀ (w : Wire 304), P w.val → ∀ δ, ext δ w = δ (fFrom w))
        (hneg : ∀ (w : Wire 304), ¬P w.val → ∀ δ, ext δ w = bg w)
        (hid : ∀ (w : Wire 304), P w.val → fTo (fFrom w) = w)
    (u : Wire 304) (hu : P u.val) (δ : BitAssignment K) (v : ZMod 2) :
    Function.update (ext δ) u v = ext (Function.update δ (fFrom u) v) := by
  funext w
  by_cases hw : P w.val
  · rw [hpos w hw]
    by_cases hwu : w = u
    · rw [hwu, Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
    · have hne : fFrom w ≠ fFrom u := fun e ↦
        hwu ((hid w hw).symm.trans ((congrArg fTo e).trans (hid u hu)))
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hwu, Function.update_of_ne hne, hpos w hw]
  · rw [hneg w hw,
        Function.update_of_ne (fun e ↦ hw ((congrArg (fun x : Wire 304 ↦ P x.val) e).mpr hu)),
        hneg w hw]

theorem pullBack_gen_fwdBits {K : ℕ} (P : ℕ → Prop) (ok : ℕ → Bool)
    (act : ComputeProg 304 → Bool) (fTo : Wire K → Wire 304) (fFrom : Wire 304 → Wire K)
    (pb : ComputeProg 304 → ComputeProg K)
    (bg : BitAssignment 304) (ext : BitAssignment K → BitAssignment 304)
        (hok : ∀ (n : ℕ), ok n = true → P n) (ha_x : ∀ u, act (.x u) = ok u.val)
        (ha_cnot : ∀ c t h, act (.cnot c t h) = (ok c.val && ok t.val))
    (ha_and : ∀ c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3, act (.andGate c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3) = (ok c1.val && ok c2.val &&
        ok a.val)) (ha_seq : ∀ p q, act (.seq p q) = (act p && act q))
    (hp_id : pb .id = .id) (hp_x : ∀ u, pb (.x u) = .x (fFrom u))
        (hp_cnot : ∀ c t h, pb (.cnot c t h) = safeCnotCP (fFrom c) (fFrom t))
        (hp_and : ∀ c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3,
      pb (.andGate c1 c2 a h1 h2 h3) = safeAndGateCP (fFrom c1) (fFrom c2) (fFrom a))
          (hp_seq : ∀ p q, pb (.seq p q) = .seq (pb p) (pb q)) (hpos : ∀ (w : Wire 304), P w.val →
          ∀ δ, ext δ w = δ (fFrom w))
    (hneg : ∀ (w : Wire 304), ¬P w.val → ∀ δ, ext δ w = bg w)
        (hid : ∀ (w : Wire 304), P w.val → fTo (fFrom w) = w) (p : ComputeProg 304)
        (ha : act p = true) (δ : BitAssignment K) :
    p.fwdBits (ext δ) = ext ((pb p).fwdBits δ) := by
  have hNe {c t} (hc : P c.val) (ht : P t.val) (hct : c ≠ t) : fFrom c ≠ fFrom t :=
    fun e ↦ hct ((hid c hc).symm.trans ((congrArg fTo e).trans (hid t ht)))
  let eu := ext_update_eq P fTo fFrom bg ext hpos hneg hid
  induction p generalizing δ with
  | id => exact congrArg (fun q ↦ ext (q.fwdBits δ)) hp_id.symm
  | x u =>
      have hu := hok u.val ((ha_x u).symm.trans ha)
      rw [hp_x, ComputeProg.fwdBits, ComputeProg.fwdBits, hpos u hu δ]
      exact eu u hu δ _
  | cnot c t hct =>
      rcases Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp ((ha_cnot c t hct).symm.trans ha) with ⟨hc, ht⟩
      rw [hp_cnot, safeCnotCP, leg_dif_neg (hNe (hok c.val hc) (hok t.val ht) hct),
        ComputeProg.fwdBits, ComputeProg.fwdBits, hpos t (hok t.val ht) δ, hpos c (hok c.val hc) δ]
      exact eu t (hok t.val ht) δ _
  | andGate c1 c2 a h12 h1a h2a =>
      rw [ha_and, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true] at ha
      have ⟨hc1, hc2, haa⟩ : P c1.val ∧ P c2.val ∧ P a.val :=
        ⟨hok c1.val ha.1.1, hok c2.val ha.1.2, hok a.val ha.2⟩
      rw [hp_and, safeAndGateCP, leg_dif_neg (hNe hc1 hc2 h12), leg_dif_neg (hNe hc1 haa h1a),
        leg_dif_neg (hNe hc2 haa h2a), ComputeProg.fwdBits, ComputeProg.fwdBits,
        hpos a haa δ, hpos c1 hc1 δ, hpos c2 hc2 δ]
      exact eu a haa δ _
  | seq p q ihp ihq =>
      rcases Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp ((ha_seq p q).symm.trans ha) with ⟨hap, haq⟩
      exact (congrArg q.fwdBits (ihp hap δ)).trans ((ihq haq _).trans (by rw [hp_seq]; rfl))

theorem tokBit_patchAx2Sha {t : DToken} (ht : tokInAx2Sha t = true) (γ : BitAssignment 304)

theorem tokMaskNT5Ax2Sha_eq (ones m : ℕ) (hones : ones.testBit m = true) {tok : DToken}

    (1 : ZMod 2) 0 = tokBitAx2Sha tok (bitsOfNT5 t m) := by
  rcases tok with ⟨_, ws, inv⟩
  have hws (l : List ℕ) (hl : (l.all fun s ↦ Nat.blt s 304) = true) (base : ℕ) :
      cond ((l.foldr (fun s acc ↦ let v := (getNT5 5 t (f304ToAx2ShaNat s)) ^^^ acc
        cond (v == 0) 0 v) base).testBit m) (1 : ZMod 2) 0 =
      l.foldr (fun s acc ↦ bitsOfNT5 (M := 30) t m (f304ToAx2Sha (w304 s)) + acc) 0 +
        cond (base.testBit m) 1 0 := by
    induction l with
    | nil => simp

      dsimp only [List.foldr]
      rw [cond_zero_eq, Nat.testBit_xor, zmod2_cond_xor, ih hl.2, f304ToAx2ShaNat_eq hl.1]
      dsimp only [bitsOfNT5]
      rw [← add_assoc]
  dsimp only [tokMaskNT5Ax2Sha, tokBitAx2Sha]
  rw [hws ws ht (cond inv ones 0), add_comm]

theorem getNT5_initNT5_30_ge22 {u : ℕ} (hge : ¬(u < 22)) (hlt : u < 30) : getNT5 5 initNT5_22 u =

  have hchk : initNT5_22_cps (fun t ↦
      (List.range 30).all fun u' ↦

  rw [initNT5_22_cps_eq] at hchk; have hu := (List.all_eq_true.mp hchk) u (List.mem_range.mpr hlt)
  have hnb : Nat.blt u 22 = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr fun hb ↦ hge (Nat.blt_eq.mp hb)

theorem mkIn30_eq_bitsOfNT5 (m : Fin 512) :

  · rw [leg_dif_neg h22]; dsimp only [bitsOfNT5]

def code9Ax2Sha (γ : BitAssignment 304) : Fin 512 :=
    ⟨finBitsVal (fun k : Fin 9 ↦ if _h : k.val < 8 then γ (w304 (40 + k.val)) else γ (w304 75)),

theorem projAx2Sha_eq_mkIn30 (γb : BitAssignment 304) (h49 : γb (w304 49) = 0)
    (h76 : γb (w304 76) = γb (w304 40) * γb (w304 41)) (h78 : γb (w304 78) = 0)
    (hcl : ∀ w : Wire 304, 100 ≤ w.val → w.val < 118 → γb w = 0) :
    projAx2Sha γb = mkIn30 (code9Ax2Sha γb) := by
  let f9 (k : Fin 9) : ZMod 2 :=
    if _h : k.val < 8 then γb (w304 (40 + k.val)) else γb (w304 75)
  have hbit (k : Fin 9) : f9 k = if (code9Ax2Sha γb).val.testBit k.val then 1 else 0 :=
    finBitsVal_testBit f9 k
  have h10 : projAx2Sha γb ⟨10, by decide⟩ = mkIn30 (code9Ax2Sha γb) ⟨10, by decide⟩ :=
    h76.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) (hbit ⟨0, by decide⟩) (hbit ⟨1, by decide⟩))
  have hlo (u : Wire 30) : u.val < 8 → fAx2ShaTo304 u = w304 (40 + u.val) := by
    fin_cases u <;> decide

  by_cases hu8 : u.val < 8
  · have hb := hbit ⟨u.val, by omega⟩
    dsimp only [f9, projAx2Sha, mkIn30, mkIn22] at hb ⊢
    rw [leg_dif_pos hu8] at hb
    rw [leg_dif_pos (by omega), leg_if_pos hu8, hlo u hu8]
    exact hb
  · fin_cases u <;> dsimp only [Fin.val_mk] at hu8 ⊢ <;> first
      | omega | exact h49 | exact h78 | exact hcl _ (by decide) (by decide)
      | simpa [projAx2Sha, fAx2ShaTo304, mkIn30, mkIn22, f9] using hbit ⟨8, by decide⟩

def f189To304 : Wire 189 → Wire 304 := fun u ↦
  if u.val < 48 then ⟨u.val, by omega⟩ else ⟨u.val + 1, by omega⟩

def f304To189 : Wire 304 → Wire 189 := fun w ↦
  if _hw : w.val < 48 then ⟨w.val, by omega⟩
  else if _hw2 : 49 ≤ w.val ∧ w.val < 190 then ⟨w.val - 1, by omega⟩
  else ⟨0, by omega⟩

def okW304_189 (n : ℕ) : Bool := Nat.blt n 48 || (Nat.ble 49 n && Nat.blt n 190)

def activeIn189 : ComputeProg 304 → Bool
  | .id => true
  | .x u => okW304_189 u.val
  | .cnot c t _ => okW304_189 c.val && okW304_189 t.val
  | .andGate c1 c2 a _ _ _ => okW304_189 c1.val && okW304_189 c2.val && okW304_189 a.val
  | .seq p q => activeIn189 p && activeIn189 q

def stepActive1_189 : List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))
  | [] => some []
  | .id :: rest => some rest
  | .x u :: rest => if okW304_189 u.val then some rest else none
  | .cnot c t _ :: rest => if okW304_189 c.val && okW304_189 t.val then some rest else none
  | .andGate c1 c2 a _ _ _ :: rest =>
      if okW304_189 c1.val && okW304_189 c2.val && okW304_189 a.val then some rest else none
  | .seq p q :: rest => some (p :: q :: rest)

def stepActivePow_189 : ℕ → List (ComputeProg 304) → Option (List (ComputeProg 304))
  | 0, ws => stepActive1_189 ws
  | d + 1, ws => match stepActivePow_189 d ws with
    | none => none
    | some ws' => stepActivePow_189 d ws'

theorem stepActive1_189_sound {ws ws' : List (ComputeProg 304)} (h : stepActive1_189 ws = some ws')
    (hall : ∀ q ∈ ws', activeIn189 q = true) :
    ∀ q ∈ ws, activeIn189 q = true :=
  stepActive1_gen_sound rfl (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl) h hall

theorem stepActivePow_189_sound :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) {ws ws' : List (ComputeProg 304)},
      stepActivePow_189 d ws = some ws' → (∀ q ∈ ws', activeIn189 q = true) → ∀ q ∈ ws,
          activeIn189 q = true :=
  stepActivePow_gen_sound stepActive1_189_sound (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)

def pullBack189 : ComputeProg 304 → ComputeProg 189
  | .id => .id
  | .x u => .x (f304To189 u)
  | .cnot c t _ => safeCnotCP (f304To189 c) (f304To189 t)
  | .andGate c1 c2 a _ _ _ => safeAndGateCP (f304To189 c1) (f304To189 c2) (f304To189 a)
  | .seq p q => .seq (pullBack189 p) (pullBack189 q)

theorem activeWire189_of_bool {n : ℕ} (h : okW304_189 n = true) : n < 48 ∨ (49 ≤ n ∧ n < 190) := by
  dsimp only [okW304_189] at h
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, Nat.blt_eq, Nat.ble_eq] at h; exact h

theorem f189_f304_id {w : Wire 304} (hw : w.val < 48 ∨ (49 ≤ w.val ∧ w.val < 190)) :
    f189To304 (f304To189 w) = w := by
  dsimp only [f189To304, f304To189]
  rcases hw with h1 | ⟨h2, h3⟩
  · rw [leg_dif_pos h1, leg_if_pos h1]

def noWriteK {K : ℕ} (u : Wire K) : ComputeProg K → Bool
  | .id => true
  | .x a => !(a == u)
  | .cnot _ t _ => !(t == u)
  | .andGate _ _ a _ _ _ => !(a == u)
  | .seq p q => noWriteK u p && noWriteK u q

theorem ne_of_not_beq {K : ℕ} {a u : Wire K} (h : (!(a == u)) = true) : u ≠ a := fun e ↦
  Bool.false_ne_true ((congrArg not (beq_iff_eq.mpr e.symm)).symm.trans h)

theorem noWriteK_fwd {K : ℕ} (u : Wire K) :
    ∀ (p : ComputeProg K), noWriteK u p = true → ∀ (γ : BitAssignment K), p.fwdBits γ u = γ u
  | .id, _, _ => rfl
  | .x _, h, _ => Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_not_beq h) _ _
  | .cnot _ _ _, h, _ => Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_not_beq h) _ _
  | .andGate _ _ _ _ _ _, h, _ => Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_not_beq h) _ _
  | .seq p q, h, γ => by
      rw [noWriteK, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      exact (noWriteK_fwd u q h.2 _).trans (noWriteK_fwd u p h.1 γ)

theorem pCol16CliffordFwd304_spec (γ : BitAssignment 304) :
    let δ := pCol16CliffordFwd304.fwdBits γ
    (∀ u : Wire 304, u.val ≠ 183 → u.val ≠ 186 → δ u = γ u) ∧ (δ (w304 183)).val * 2 ^ 16 +
        (δ (w304 186)).val * 2 ^ 17 =
      (196608 + ((γ (w304 183)).val * 2 ^ 16 + (γ (w304 186)).val * 2 ^ 17)) % 262144 := by
  let s1 := (ComputeProg.x (w304 183)).fwdBits γ
  have es1 : s1 = Function.update γ (w304 183) (γ (w304 183) + 1) := upd_xK (w304 183) γ rfl
  have es2 : pCol16CliffordFwd304.fwdBits γ =
      Function.update s1 (w304 186) (γ (w304 186) + (γ (w304 183) + 1)) :=
          upd_cnotK (by decide) s1
      (by rw [es1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_self])
  dsimp only
  rw [es2, es1]
  refine ⟨fun u h183 h186 ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun e ↦ h186 (congrArg Fin.val e)),
        Function.update_of_ne (fun e ↦ h183 (congrArg Fin.val e))]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
    exact zmod2_col16_clifford _ _

theorem finalPoolFwd21_col16_col0_spec (γ1 γd : BitAssignment 304) (o49 : γd (w304 49) = 0)

  generalize pCol16CliffordFwd304.fwdBits γd = γc at hc16_keep hc16_sum ⊢

  have h187c : γc (w304 187) = 0 := (hc16_keep (w304 187) (by decide) (by decide)).trans h187d

  have hcol0_eq : poolSum [(0, [24], true), (0, [32], true), (0, [40], true)] γc =

    intro u hu; simp only [inNatList, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hu;
    exact hc16_keep u hu.1 hu.2.1
  rw [hcol0_eq] at hc0_sum
  have hcst16 := poolSum_cst16_17 γd
  have htail2 : poolSum [(16, [183], false), (17, [186], false)] γd = (γd (w304 183)).val * 2 ^ 16 +

    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by

  rw [h183_eq, h186_eq] at hc16_sum;
  rw [midPoolFwd_prefix_eq 14 le_rfl γd, hmid_eq, ← hc0_sum] at hpool_split
  set low16 := (γf (w304 49)).val + 2 * (γf (w304 187)).val +
    (∑ i : Fin 14, ((γf (d2WireFwd304 ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩)).val * 2 ^ (i.val + 2) : ℕ))
  set hi2 := (γf (w304 183)).val * 2 ^ 16 + (γf (w304 186)).val * 2 ^ 17

  have hlt18 : finBitsVal (fun k : Fin 18 => γf (d2WireFwd304 k)) < 262144 := finBitsVal_lt _

theorem clampPotBRefl_nucFlags3XorBits {n : ℕ} (rTot : QRegister dLayout n)
    (β : BitAssignment n) :
    let δ := nucFlags3XorBits rTot β
    clampPotBRefl rTot δ =
      fun w ↦
        if w = rTot wOut0 then δ (rTot wOut0)
        else if w = rTot wOut1 then δ (rTot wOut1)
        else if w = rTot wOut15 then δ (rTot wOut15)
        else clampPotBRefl rTot β w := by
  intro δ
  obtain ⟨hvS, hvP, hvN⟩ := val_wPotFlags_rPot0Layout
  obtain ⟨_, fS1, fN1, fO1⟩ := clampFlags_apply rTot δ
  obtain ⟨_, fS2, fN2, fO2⟩ := clampFlags_apply rTot β
  obtain ⟨cN1, cE1, cO1⟩ := clampOneHot_apply rTot (clampFlags rTot δ)
  obtain ⟨cN2, cE2, cO2⟩ := clampOneHot_apply rTot (clampFlags rTot β)
  have kP : δ _ = _ := nucFlags3XorBits_of_val rTot β (wPotIsPot rPot0Layout) (by simp [hvP])
  have kS : δ _ = _ := nucFlags3XorBits_of_val rTot β (wPotIsScreen rPot0Layout) (by simp [hvS])
  have kN : δ _ = _ := nucFlags3XorBits_of_val rTot β (wPotIsNN rPot0Layout) (by simp [hvN])
  have hFlEq (u : Wire dLayout) (hu : u.val ≠ 5715 ∧ u.val ≠ 5716 ∧ u.val ≠ 5730) :
      clampFlags rTot δ (rTot u) = clampFlags rTot β (rTot u) := by
    by_cases hwS : rTot u = rTot (wPotIsScreen rPot0Layout)
    · rw [hwS, fS1, fS2, kP, kS]
    by_cases hwN : rTot u = rTot (wPotIsNN rPot0Layout)
    · rw [hwN, fN1, fN2, kP, kS, kN]
    exact (fO1 _ hwS hwN).trans ((nucFlags3XorBits_of_val rTot β u hu).trans (fO2 _ hwS hwN).symm)
  have neR {u v : Wire dLayout} (e : rTot u = rTot v) : u.val = v.val :=
    congrArg Fin.val (rTot.wires.injective e)
  have hAtOut (u : Wire dLayout) (hu : 5715 ≤ u.val ∧ u.val ≤ 5730) :
      clampPotBRefl rTot δ (rTot u) = δ (rTot u) :=
    (cO1 _ (fun b e ↦ absurd ((neR e).trans (val_bufHi_nuc b)) (by omega))
      (fun b e ↦ absurd ((neR e).trans (val_bufHi_elec b)) (by omega))).trans
      (fO1 _ (fun e ↦ absurd ((neR e).trans hvS) (by omega))
        (fun e ↦ absurd ((neR e).trans hvN) (by omega)))
  funext w
  split_ifs with c0 c1 c15
  · exact c0 ▸ hAtOut wOut0 (by simp [val_wOut0])
  · exact c1 ▸ hAtOut wOut1 (by simp [val_wOut1])
  · exact c15 ▸ hAtOut wOut15 (by simp [val_wOut15])
  dsimp only [clampPotBRefl]
  rcases Classical.em (∃ b, w = rTot (rBufHi rNucLayout b)) with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | hwN
  · rw [cN1 b, cN2 b, hFlEq _ (by simp [hvN]), hFlEq _ (by rw [val_bufHi_nuc]; omega)]
  rcases Classical.em (∃ b, w = rTot (rBufHi rElecLayout b)) with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | hwE
  · rw [cE1 b, cE2 b, hFlEq _ (by simp [hvN]), hFlEq _ (by rw [val_bufHi_elec]; omega)]
  rw [cO1 w (fun b e ↦ hwN ⟨b, e⟩) (fun b e ↦ hwE ⟨b, e⟩),
    cO2 w (fun b e ↦ hwN ⟨b, e⟩) (fun b e ↦ hwE ⟨b, e⟩)]

  · exact hwS ▸ hFlEq _ (by simp [hvS])
  by_cases hwNN : w = rTot (wPotIsNN rPot0Layout)
  · exact hwNN ▸ hFlEq _ (by simp [hvN])
  exact (fO1 w hwS hwNN).trans
    ((nucFlags3XorBits_of_ne rTot β c0 c1 c15).trans (fO2 w hwS hwNN).symm)

theorem evalPrimGate_pureCnot_zero {M c : ℕ} (h : Nat.beq (c % 4) 1 = true) : evalPrimGate M 0 c =
    0 := by
  unfold evalPrimGate; dsimp only
  have h0 : Nat.beq (c % 4) 0 = false := by have heq := Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true h; rw [heq]; rfl
  simp [h0, h]

theorem evalPrimGate_pureCnot_xor {M a b c : ℕ} (h : Nat.beq (c % 4) 1 = true) :
    evalPrimGate M (a ^^^ b) c = evalPrimGate M a c ^^^ evalPrimGate M b c := by
  unfold evalPrimGate; dsimp only
  have h0 : Nat.beq (c % 4) 0 = false := by have heq := Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true h; rw [heq]; rfl
  set w1 := ((c >>> 2) % 512) % (M + 1)
  set w2 := ((c >>> 11) % 512) % (M + 1)
  simp only [h0, h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Nat.testBit_xor]
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro k
  cases Nat.beq w1 w2 <;> cases a.testBit w1 <;> cases b.testBit w1 <;>
    simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_and, Bool.false_and, Bool.true_xor,
        Bool.false_xor, ↓reduceIte,
      Bool.false_eq_true, Nat.testBit_xor] <;>
    cases a.testBit k <;> cases b.testBit k <;>
    try (cases (1 <<< w2).testBit k) <;> rfl

    ∀ {t : PrimTree}, isPureCnotTree t = true → evalPrimTree M 0 t = 0
  | .empty, _ => rfl
  | .leaf c, h => evalPrimGate_pureCnot_zero h
  | .node l r, h => by
      rcases Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h with ⟨hL, hR⟩
      dsimp only [evalPrimTree]; rw [evalPrimTree_pureCnot_zero hL, evalPrimTree_pureCnot_zero hR]

      evalPrimTree M (a ^^^ b) t = evalPrimTree M a t ^^^ evalPrimTree M b t
  | .empty, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .leaf c, _, _, h => evalPrimGate_pureCnot_xor h
  | .node l r, a, b, h => by
      rcases Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h with ⟨hL, hR⟩

  | leaf c =>
      intro s hs; dsimp only [evalPrimTree]; unfold evalPrimGate; dsimp only
      have hw1 : ((c >>> 2) % 512) % (M + 1) < M + 1 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      have hw2 : ((c >>> 11) % 512) % (M + 1) < M + 1 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      have hw3 : ((c >>> 20) % 512) % (M + 1) < M + 1 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      have hsh (w : ℕ) (hw : w < M + 1) : (1 <<< w).testBit u = false := by
        rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, one_mul, Nat.testBit_two_pow]; simp [show w ≠ u by omega]
      split_ifs <;> simp [Nat.testBit_xor, hs, hsh _ hw1, hsh _ hw2, hsh _ hw3]
  | node l r ihl ihr => intro s hs; exact ihr _ (ihl _ hs)

def packBits (f : ℕ → Bool) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => packBits f m ^^^ (if f m then 1 <<< m else 0)

theorem packBits_testBit (f : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∀ (m k : ℕ), (packBits f m).testBit k = (if k < m then f k else false)
  | 0, k => by simp [packBits]
  | m + 1, k => by
      dsimp only [packBits]
      rw [Nat.testBit_xor, packBits_testBit f m k]
      rcases eq_or_ne m k with rfl | hmk
      · cases f m <;> simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
      · have hlt : (k < m + 1) ↔ (k < m) := by omega
        cases f m <;> simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, hmk, hlt]

def bitPref (x : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ := packBits x.testBit

theorem bitPref_eq (x B : ℕ) (hx : x < 2 ^ B) : bitPref x B = x := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq; intro k
  unfold bitPref; rw [packBits_testBit]
  by_cases hk : k < B
  · simp [hk]
  · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte]
    exact (Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt
      (hx.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) (by omega : B ≤ k)))).symm

theorem xorLinear_bitPref (F : ℕ → Bool) (x B sel : ℕ)
    (h0 : F 0 = false) (hXor : ∀ a b, F (a ^^^ b) = xor (F a) (F b))
    (hBasis : ∀ i < B, F (1 <<< i) = decide (i = sel)) :
    ∀ m ≤ B, F (bitPref x m) = (decide (sel < m) && x.testBit sel)
  | 0, _ => by simp [bitPref, packBits, h0]
  | m + 1, hm => by
      change F (bitPref x m ^^^ (if x.testBit m then 1 <<< m else 0)) = _
      rw [hXor, xorLinear_bitPref F x B sel h0 hXor hBasis m (by omega)]
      rcases eq_or_ne m sel with rfl | hms
      · cases x.testBit m <;> simp [h0, hBasis m (by omega)]
      · have hlt : (sel < m + 1) ↔ (sel < m) := by omega
        cases x.testBit m <;> simp [h0, hBasis m (by omega), hms, hlt]

theorem xorLinear_bit_eq (F : ℕ → Bool) (x B sel : ℕ) (hx : x < 2 ^ B) (h0 : F 0 = false)
    (hXor : ∀ a b, F (a ^^^ b) = xor (F a) (F b))
    (hBasis : ∀ i < B, F (1 <<< i) = decide (i = sel)) : F x = x.testBit sel := by
  have h1 :=
      xorLinear_bitPref F x B sel h0 hXor hBasis B le_rfl; rw [bitPref_eq x B hx] at h1; rw [h1]
  by_cases hs : sel < B
  · simp [hs]
  · simp only [hs, decide_false, Bool.false_and]
    exact (Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt
      (hx.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) (by omega : B ≤ sel)))).symm

theorem xorLinear_zero_eq (F : ℕ → Bool) (x B : ℕ) (hx : x < 2 ^ B) (h0 : F 0 = false)
    (hXor : ∀ a b, F (a ^^^ b) = xor (F a) (F b)) (hBasis : ∀ i < B, F (1 <<< i) = false) : F x =
    false := by
  have h := xorLinear_bit_eq F x B B hx h0 hXor (fun i hi ↦ by simp [hBasis i hi, Nat.ne_of_lt hi])
  rw [h]; exact Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt hx

theorem stepCB_writeReg_comm {w1 w2 N : ℕ} (r1 : QRegister w1 N) (r2 : QRegister w2 N)
    (hDisj : r1.DisjointWires r2) (f : BitAssignment w1 → BitAssignment w1) (β : BitAssignment N)
    (vals : Fin w2 → ZMod 2) : stepCB r1 f (writeReg β r2 vals) =
    writeReg (stepCB r1 f β) r2 vals := by
  funext w
  have hfEq : (fun k ↦ writeReg β r2 vals (r1 k)) = (fun k ↦ β (r1 k)) :=
    funext fun k ↦ writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ disj_ne hDisj k j hj.symm)
  by_cases hw2 : ∃ j : Fin w2, r2 j = w
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hw2; rw [writeReg_apply_reg]; unfold stepCB
    rw [writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ disj_ne hDisj i j hi), writeReg_apply_reg]
  · rw [writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw2]; unfold stepCB
    by_cases hw1 : ∃ i : Fin w1, r1 i = w
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hw1; rw [writeReg_apply_reg, writeReg_apply_reg, hfEq]
    · rw [writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw1, writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw1,
          writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw2]

theorem stepCB_apply_disj {w1 N : ℕ} (r1 : QRegister w1 N) (f : BitAssignment w1 → BitAssignment w1)
    (β : BitAssignment N) (w : Wire N) (hw : ¬∃ i : Fin w1, r1 i = w) : stepCB r1 f β w = β w := by
  unfold stepCB; exact writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw

theorem wRouterDisj_bf6_31 {n : ℕ} {rBasis9 : QRegister 9 n} {rCopy30 : QRegister 30 n}
    {rScr31 : QRegister 31 n} {rYHi33 : QRegister 33 n}
    (hBS : rBasis9.DisjointWires rScr31) (hCS : rCopy30.DisjointWires rScr31)
    (hBY : rBasis9.DisjointWires rYHi33) (hCY : rCopy30.DisjointWires rYHi33)
    (hSY : rScr31.DisjointWires rYHi33) :
    WRouterDisj (rScr31 ⟨0, by decide⟩) (bfIdx3 rBasis9 rCopy30) (bfOut6_31 rScr31)
      (rYHi33 ⟨0, by decide⟩) where
  has_ne_out e := rScr31_ne rScr31 (early6_ne_scr0 e).symm
  has_ne_q := disj_ne hSY _ _
  idx_ne_out d _ := by fin_cases d <;> first | exact disj_ne hCS _ _ | exact disj_ne hBS _ _
  idx_ne_q d := by fin_cases d <;> first | exact disj_ne hCY _ _ | exact disj_ne hBY _ _
  out_inj _ _ hij := rScr31_ne rScr31 fun eqIdx ↦ hij (early6ScrIdx_inj eqIdx)
  out_ne_q _ := disj_ne hSY _ _

def cBfGatherA01_31 {n : ℕ} (rScr31 : QRegister 31 n) : Circuit n :=
  Circuit.CNOT (bfOut6_31 rScr31 ⟨3, by decide⟩) (rScr31 ⟨29, by decide⟩)
    (rScr31_ne rScr31 (early6_ne_scr29 ⟨3, by decide⟩)) ;;ᶜ
  Circuit.CNOT (bfOut6_31 rScr31 ⟨5, by decide⟩) (rScr31 ⟨30, by decide⟩)
    (rScr31_ne rScr31 (early6_ne_scr30 ⟨5, by decide⟩))

theorem count_cBfGatherA01_31 {n : ℕ} (rScr31 : QRegister 31 n) :
    (cBfGatherA01_31 rScr31).count .T = 0 ∧ (cBfGatherA01_31 rScr31).count .TOFF = 0 := by
  simp [cBfGatherA01_31, Circuit.count_seq, Circuit.CNOT]
theorem cBfGatherA01_31_mulVec_ket {n : ℕ} (rScr31 : QRegister 31 n) (η : BitAssignment n) :
    (cBfGatherA01_31 rScr31).eval.1.mulVec (ket η) =
      ket (Function.update
        (Function.update η (rScr31 ⟨29, by decide⟩)
          (η (rScr31 ⟨29, by decide⟩) + η (bfOut6_31 rScr31 ⟨3, by decide⟩)))
        (rScr31 ⟨30, by decide⟩)
        (η (rScr31 ⟨30, by decide⟩) + η (bfOut6_31 rScr31 ⟨5, by decide⟩))) := by
  dsimp only [cBfGatherA01_31]; rw [eval_seq_mulVec, ket_CNOT, ket_CNOT]
  have n5_29 : bfOut6_31 rScr31 ⟨5, by decide⟩ ≠ rScr31 ⟨29, by decide⟩ :=
    rScr31_ne rScr31 (early6_ne_scr29 ⟨5, by decide⟩)
  have n30_29 : rScr31 ⟨30, by decide⟩ ≠ rScr31 ⟨29, by decide⟩ := rScr31_ne rScr31 (by decide)
  simp only [Function.update_of_ne n5_29, Function.update_of_ne n30_29]

    (rCopy30 : QRegister 30 n) (rScr31 : QRegister 31 n) (rYHi33 : QRegister 33 n) :
    DynamicCircuit Var n :=
  .seq (.circuit (Circuit.X (rScr31 ⟨0, by decide⟩)))
    (.seq ((wRouterBracket3x2k 1).wrap v (rScr31 ⟨0, by decide⟩)
            (bfIdx3 rBasis9 rCopy30) (bfOut6_31 rScr31) (rYHi33 ⟨0, by decide⟩)

theorem pBfRouter6_31_counts_wires {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} {S : Wire n → Prop} (v : Var)
    (rBasis9 : QRegister 9 n) (rCopy30 : QRegister 30 n) (rScr31 : QRegister 31 n)
    (rYHi33 : QRegister 33 n) (hrB : ∀ i, S (rBasis9 i)) (hrC : ∀ j, S (rCopy30 j))
    (hrS : ∀ u, S (rScr31 u)) (hrY : ∀ b, S (rYHi33 b)) :
    (pBfRouter6_31 v rBasis9 rCopy30 rScr31 rYHi33).count .T = 6 ∧
    (pBfRouter6_31 v rBasis9 rCopy30 rScr31 rYHi33).count .TOFF = 0 ∧
    DynWires S (pBfRouter6_31 v rBasis9 rCopy30 rScr31 rYHi33) := by
  let pG : DynamicCircuit Var n := .circuit (cBfGatherA01_31 rScr31)
  obtain ⟨tW, fW⟩ := (wRouterBracket3x2k 1).count_wrap v (rScr31 ⟨0, by decide⟩)
    (bfIdx3 rBasis9 rCopy30) (bfOut6_31 rScr31) (rYHi33 ⟨0, by decide⟩) pG
  obtain ⟨tG, fG⟩ := count_cBfGatherA01_31 rScr31
  have hIdxS : ∀ d, S (bfIdx3 rBasis9 rCopy30 d) := fun d ↦ by
    fin_cases d <;> [exact hrC _; exact hrB _; exact hrB _]
  have cwG : CircWires S (cBfGatherA01_31 rScr31) :=
      ⟨cw_cnot (hrS _) (hrS _), cw_cnot (hrS _) (hrS _)⟩
  have dwW := (wRouterBracket3x2k 1).dynWires_wrap v (rScr31 ⟨0, by decide⟩)
    (bfIdx3 rBasis9 rCopy30) (bfOut6_31 rScr31) (rYHi33 ⟨0, by decide⟩) pG
    (hrS _) hIdxS (fun _ ↦ hrS _) (hrY _) cwG
  unfold pBfRouter6_31; refine ⟨?_, ?_, ⟨cw_1 (hrS _), dwW, cw_1 (hrS _)⟩⟩
  · dsimp only [DynamicCircuit.count, pG] at tW ⊢
    rw [tW, tG]; simp [Circuit.X]
  · dsimp only [DynamicCircuit.count, pG] at fW ⊢
    rw [fW, fG]; simp [Circuit.X]

theorem subspaceStep_pBfRouter6_31 {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var]

    (hz30 : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → stP δ (rScr31 ⟨30, by decide⟩) = 0)

theorem fI85_ne_scr_tail {n : ℕ} {rBasis9 : QRegister 9 n} {rCopy30 : QRegister 30 n}

  · exact disj_ne hCS _ _

  · intro eqW; have hIdx := rScr31.wires.injective eqW
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨e, rfl⟩
    · exact keep22_ne_scr0 _ hIdx
    · exact keep22_ne_scr29 _ hIdx
    · exact keep22_ne_scr30 _ hIdx

          else bfOut6_31 rScr31 ⟨z.val - 88, by omega⟩) = rScr31 s ∧

    · obtain ⟨s, hsEq, hsProp⟩ :=

inductive Res118 where
  | mk : Bool → ℕ → CT → Res118

def mkRes118 (ok : Bool) (t : ℕ) (ct : CT) : Res118 :=
  match ok, syncNat t, ct with
  | false, tn, .leaf a => .mk false tn (.leaf a)
  | false, tn, .node a b => .mk false tn (.node a b)
  | true, tn, .leaf a => .mk true tn (.leaf a)
  | true, tn, .node a b => .mk true tn (.node a b)

theorem mkRes118_eq (ok : Bool) (t : ℕ) (ct : CT) : mkRes118 ok t ct = .mk ok t ct := by
  cases ok <;> cases t <;> cases ct <;> rfl

def okX118 (w1 : ℕ) : Bool := decide (w1 < 118)
def okCnot118 (w1 w2 : ℕ) : Bool := decide (w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2)
def okTri118 (w1 w2 w3 : ℕ) : Bool :=
    decide (w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w3 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧ w1 ≠ w3 ∧ w2 ≠ w3)
def okWr118 (w1 w2 : ℕ) : Bool :=
    decide (w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧ (w1 < 18 ∨ 28 < w1) ∧ (w2 < 18 ∨ 28 < w2))
def cln21_28 (cols : CT) : Bool :=
    Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 21) 0 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 22) 0 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 23) 0 &&
    Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 24) 0 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 25) 0 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 26) 0 &&
    Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 27) 0 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 28) 0
def evalStep118 (cols : CT) (c : ℕ) : Res118 :=
  let tg := c % 8
  let w1 := (c / 8) % 128
  let w2 := (c / 1024) % 128
  let w3 := (c / 131072) % 128
  if Nat.beq tg 0 then
    if okX118 w1 then mkRes118 true 0 (xorStrict 7 cols w1 (repMask 10))
    else .mk false 0 cols
  else if Nat.beq tg 1 then
    if okCnot118 w1 w2 then mkRes118 true 0 (xorStrict 7 cols w2 (getCT 7 cols w1))
    else .mk false 0 cols
  else if Nat.beq tg 2 then
    if okTri118 w1 w2 w3 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols w3) 0 then
      mkRes118 true 4 (xorStrict 7 cols w3 (getCT 7 cols w1 &&& getCT 7 cols w2))
    else .mk false 0 cols
  else if Nat.beq tg 3 then
    if okTri118 w1 w2 w3 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols w3) (getCT 7 cols w1 &&& getCT 7 cols w2) then
      mkRes118 true 0 (xorStrict 7 cols w3 (getCT 7 cols w3))
    else .mk false 0 cols
  else if Nat.beq tg 4 then
    if okWr118 w1 w2 && Nat.beq (getCT 7 cols 18 &&& getCT 7 cols 19) 0 && cln21_28 cols then
      let c1 := xorStrict 7 cols w1 (getCT 7 cols 18 &&& getCT 7 cols 20)
      let c2 := xorStrict 7 c1 w2 (getCT 7 c1 19 &&& getCT 7 c1 20)
      mkRes118 true 6 c2
    else .mk false 0 cols
  else .mk false 0 cols

def evalTree118 : CT → PrimTree → Res118
  | cols, .empty => .mk true 0 cols
  | cols, .leaf c => evalStep118 cols c
  | cols, .node l r =>
      match evalTree118 cols l with
      | .mk false _ ct1 => .mk false 0 ct1
      | .mk true t1 ct1 =>
          match evalTree118 ct1 r with
          | .mk false _ ct2 => .mk false 0 ct2
          | .mk true t2 ct2 => mkRes118 true (t1 + t2) ct2

theorem initCT_testBit_of_allLt {inCT : CT}
    (h1 : allLt 10 (fun b ↦ Nat.beq (getCT 7 inCT b) (coordCol 10 b)) = true)
    (h2 : allLt 108 (fun u ↦ Nat.beq (getCT 7 inCT (10 + u)) 0) = true)
    (idx : ℕ) (hIdx : idx < 1024) (w : ℕ) (hw : w < 118) :
    (getCT 7 inCT w).testBit idx = (decide (w < 10) && idx.testBit w) := by
  by_cases hw10 : w < 10
  · have hc := Nat.beq_eq.mp (allLt_spec h1 w hw10)
    rw [hc, coordCol_testBit 10 w idx hw10]
    simp [hw10, hIdx]
  · have hc := Nat.beq_eq.mp (allLt_spec h2 (w - 10) (by omega))
    have hadd : 10 + (w - 10) = w := by omega
    rw [hadd] at hc
    rw [hc, Nat.zero_testBit]
    simp [hw10]

    (getCT 7 outCT b).testBit idx = idx.testBit b := by

    (idx : ℕ) (u : ℕ) (hu : u < 78) :
    (getCT 7 outCT (40 + u)).testBit idx = false := by

theorem outCT_out_testBit_of_allLt {outCT : CT}
    (h5 : allLt 30 (fun j ↦ Nat.beq (getCT 7 outCT (10 + j) &&& repMask 9) 0 &&
      Nat.beq (getCT 7 outCT (10 + j) >>> 512) (dualLegExpCols36.getD (6 + j) 0)) = true)
    (idx : ℕ) (hIdx : idx < 1024) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 30) :
    (getCT 7 outCT (10 + j)).testBit idx = (gGatedShr6Word word512DualLeg idx).testBit j := by
  rcases Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (allLt_spec h5 j hj) with ⟨hLo, hHi⟩
  unfold gGatedShr6Word
  by_cases h512 : idx < 512
  · have ht := congrArg (·.testBit idx) (Nat.beq_eq.mp hLo)
    rw [Nat.testBit_and, repMask_testBit 9 idx,
      decide_eq_true (show idx < 2 ^ 9 by omega), Bool.and_true] at ht
    simpa only [h512, ↓reduceIte, Nat.zero_testBit] using ht
  · simp only [h512, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [← show (getCT 7 outCT (10 + j) >>> 512).testBit (idx - 512) =
        (getCT 7 outCT (10 + j)).testBit idx by
      rw [Nat.testBit_shiftRight, show 512 + (idx - 512) = idx by omega], Nat.beq_eq.mp hHi,
      word512DualLeg_testBit_eq_expCols36 (by omega) (by omega), Nat.testBit_shiftRight]

def z2b (b : Bool) : ZMod 2 := if b then 1 else 0

theorem z2b_false : z2b false = 0 := rfl
theorem z2b_not (b : Bool) : z2b (!b) = z2b b + 1 := by
  cases b <;> decide

theorem z2b_xor (a b : Bool) : z2b (xor a b) = z2b a + z2b b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> decide

theorem z2b_and (a b : Bool) : z2b (a && b) = z2b a * z2b b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> decide

theorem z2b_beq_one (x : ZMod 2) : z2b (x == 1) = x := by
  rcases DynCircExt.bit_cases x with rfl | rfl <;> decide

theorem xorStrict7_testBit (cols : CT) (u w x idx : ℕ) (hu : u < 118)
    (hw : w < 118) : (getCT 7 (xorStrict 7 cols w x) u).testBit idx = if w =
    u then xor ((getCT 7 cols u).testBit idx)
    (x.testBit idx) else (getCT 7 cols u).testBit idx := by
  have hu7 : u < 2 ^ 7 := by norm_num; omega
  have hw7 : w < 2 ^ 7 := by norm_num; omega
  rw [xorStrict_eq, getCT_xorCT 7 cols u w x hu7 hw7]
  by_cases hwu : w = u
  · subst hwu; simp [Nat.testBit_xor]
  · simp [hwu]

    r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne (by dsimp [wrOut6_118, dst1]; omega))
  let cMid : Circuit n :=
    Circuit.CNOT (r (wrOut6_118 ⟨3, by decide⟩)) (r dst0) h0 ;;ᶜ
    Circuit.CNOT (r (wrOut6_118 ⟨5, by decide⟩)) (r dst1) h1
  have cMidT : cMid.count .T = 0 := by dsimp only [cMid]; rw [Circuit.count_seq, cnotT, cnotT]
  have cMidF : cMid.count .TOFF = 0 := by dsimp only [cMid]; rw [Circuit.count_seq, cnotF, cnotF]
  obtain ⟨tw, fw⟩ :=
      (wRouterBracket3x2k 1).count_wrap v (r wrHas_118) (fun d ↦ r (wrIdx3_118 d))
      (fun m ↦ r (wrOut6_118 m)) (r wrEnc_118) (.circuit cMid)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [DynamicCircuit.count] at tw ⊢
    rw [tw, cMidT]; simp [Circuit.X]
  · dsimp only [DynamicCircuit.count] at fw ⊢
    rw [fw, cMidF]; simp [Circuit.X]

def toDynStep118 {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} (v : Var) (r : QRegister 118 n)
    (c : ℕ) : DynamicCircuit Var n :=
  let tg := c % 8
  let w1 := (c / 8) % 128
  let w2 := (c / 1024) % 128
  let w3 := (c / 131072) % 128
  if tg = 0 then
    if h : w1 < 118 then .circuit (Circuit.X (r ⟨w1, h⟩))
    else .circuit Circuit.identity
  else if tg = 1 then
    if h : w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 then
      .circuit (Circuit.CNOT (r ⟨w1, h.1⟩) (r ⟨w2, h.2.1⟩)
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2)))
    else .circuit Circuit.identity
  else if tg = 2 then
    if h : w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w3 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧ w1 ≠ w3 ∧ w2 ≠ w3 then
      .circuit (andComputeCircuit (r ⟨w1, h.1⟩) (r ⟨w2, h.2.1⟩) (r ⟨w3, h.2.2.1⟩)
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2.2.1))
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2.2.2.1))
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2.2.2.2)))
    else .circuit Circuit.identity
  else if tg = 3 then
    if h : w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w3 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧ w1 ≠ w3 ∧ w2 ≠ w3 then
      andUncomputeDyn v (r ⟨w1, h.1⟩) (r ⟨w2, h.2.1⟩) (r ⟨w3, h.2.2.1⟩)
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2.2.1))
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2.2.2.1))
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne h.2.2.2.2.2))
    else .circuit Circuit.identity
  else if tg = 4 then
    if h : w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧ (w1 < 18 ∨ 28 < w1) ∧ (w2 < 18 ∨ 28 < w2) then
      pWrDual118 v r w1 w2 h
    else .circuit Circuit.identity
  else .circuit Circuit.identity

def toDynTree118 {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} (v : Var) (r : QRegister 118 n) :
    PrimTree → DynamicCircuit Var n
  | .empty => .circuit Circuit.identity
  | .leaf c => toDynStep118 v r c
  | .node l rt => .seq (toDynTree118 v r l) (toDynTree118 v r rt)

theorem dynWires_toDynStep118 {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} {S : Wire n → Prop} (v : Var)
    (r : QRegister 118 n) (hr : ∀ i : Fin 118, S (r i)) (c : ℕ) : DynWires S (toDynStep118 v r c)

  dsimp only [toDynStep118]; split_ifs
  · exact cw_1 (hr _)
  · trivial
  · exact cw_cnot (hr _) (hr _)
  · trivial
  · exact cw_andComputeCircuit118 (hr _) (hr _) (hr _)
  · trivial
  · exact dynWires_andUncomputeDyn118 v (hr _) (hr _) (hr _)
  · trivial
  · exact ⟨cw_1 (hr _),
      (wRouterBracket3x2k 1).dynWires_wrap v _ _ _ _ _
        (hr _) (fun _ ↦ hr _) (fun _ ↦ hr _) (hr _)
        ⟨cw_cnot (hr _) (hr _), cw_cnot (hr _) (hr _)⟩,
      cw_1 (hr _)⟩
  · trivial
  · trivial

theorem dynWires_toDynTree118 {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} {S : Wire n → Prop}
    (v : Var) (r : QRegister 118 n) (hr : ∀ i : Fin 118, S (r i)) :
    ∀ t : PrimTree, DynWires S (toDynTree118 v r t)

theorem idxValPrefix_map_reg118 {D n : ℕ} (r : QRegister 118 n) (wIdx : Fin D → Wire 118)
    (γ : BitAssignment n) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ D),
      idxValPrefix (fun d ↦ r (wIdx d)) γ m hm = idxValPrefix wIdx (fun k ↦ γ (r k)) m hm
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, hm => by
      dsimp only [idxValPrefix]; rw [idxValPrefix_map_reg118 r wIdx γ m (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm)]
theorem idxValD_map_reg118 {D n : ℕ} (r : QRegister 118 n) (wIdx : Fin D → Wire 118)
    (γ : BitAssignment n) : idxValD (fun d ↦ r (wIdx d)) γ = idxValD wIdx (fun k ↦ γ (r k)) :=
    idxValPrefix_map_reg118 r wIdx γ D le_rfl
theorem toggleOneHotBits_map_reg118 {D N n : ℕ} (r : QRegister 118 n) (wHas : Wire 118)
    (wIdx : Fin D → Wire 118) (wOut : Fin N → Wire 118) (γ : BitAssignment n)
    (u : Wire 118) : toggleOneHotBits (r wHas) (fun d ↦ r (wIdx d)) (fun j ↦ r (wOut j)) γ (r u) =
    toggleOneHotBits wHas wIdx wOut (fun k ↦ γ (r k)) u := by
  have hIdx := idxValD_map_reg118 r wIdx γ; dsimp only [toggleOneHotBits]
  by_cases h : idxValD wIdx (fun k ↦ γ (r k)) < N
  · have h' : idxValD (fun d ↦ r (wIdx d)) γ < N := hIdx ▸ h
    rw [leg_dif_pos h', leg_dif_pos h]
    have hFin : (⟨idxValD (fun d ↦ r (wIdx d)) γ, h'⟩ : Fin N) =
        ⟨idxValD wIdx (fun k ↦ γ (r k)), h⟩ := Fin.ext hIdx
    rw [hFin]
    by_cases hu : u = wOut ⟨idxValD wIdx (fun k ↦ γ (r k)), h⟩
    · subst hu; rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (r.wires.injective.ne hu), Function.update_of_ne hu]
  · have h' : ¬ idxValD (fun d ↦ r (wIdx d)) γ < N := hIdx ▸ h
    rw [leg_dif_neg h', leg_dif_neg h]

theorem wrIdxVal_props118 (bu d0 d1 : Bool) (hDisj : (d0 && d1) = false) (β : BitAssignment 118)
    (hU : β wrU_118 = z2b bu) (h0 : β wrD0_118 = z2b d0) (h1 : β wrD1_118 = z2b d1) :
    idxValD wrIdx3_118 β < 3 * 2 ^ 1 ∧ (if idxValD wrIdx3_118 β = 3 then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0) =
    z2b (d0 && bu) ∧ (if idxValD wrIdx3_118 β = 5 then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0) = z2b (d1 && bu) := by
  have h0_eq : wrIdx3_118 ⟨0, by decide⟩ = wrU_118 := rfl
  have h1_eq : wrIdx3_118 ⟨1, by decide⟩ = wrD0_118 := rfl
  have h2_eq : wrIdx3_118 ⟨2, by decide⟩ = wrD1_118 := rfl
  have hExpand : idxValD wrIdx3_118 β = (if z2b bu = 1 then 1 else 0) +
      (if z2b d0 = 1 then 2 else 0) + (if z2b d1 = 1 then 4 else 0) := by
    dsimp only [idxValD, idxValPrefix]; rw [h0_eq, h1_eq, h2_eq, hU, h0, h1]
    cases bu <;> cases d0 <;> cases d1 <;> decide
  rw [hExpand]
  revert hDisj
  cases bu <;> cases d0 <;> cases d1 <;> decide

theorem stOfCT_update_xorStrict7 {n : ℕ} (r : QRegister 118 n)
    (st0 : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n)
    (idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ) (cols : CT) (wt : ℕ) (hwt : wt < 118) (mask : ℕ)
        (δ : BitAssignment n) (val : ZMod 2)
    (hval : val = z2b (xor ((getCT 7 cols wt).testBit (idxOf δ)) (mask.testBit (idxOf δ)))) :
    Function.update (stOfCT r st0 idxOf cols δ)
        (r ⟨wt, hwt⟩) val = stOfCT r st0 idxOf (xorStrict 7 cols wt mask) δ := by
  funext w
  by_cases hmem : w ∈ Set.range r.wires
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hmem
    by_cases hwu : wt = u.val
    · obtain rfl : u = ⟨wt, hwt⟩ := Fin.ext hwu.symm
      rw [Function.update_self, stOfCT_reg, xorStrict7_testBit cols wt wt mask (idxOf δ) hwt hwt,
          ite_eq_left rfl, hval]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne (Ne.symm hwu))), stOfCT_reg,
          stOfCT_reg,
          xorStrict7_testBit cols u.val wt mask (idxOf δ) u.isLt hwt, ite_eq_right hwu]
  · dsimp only [stOfCT]
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun e ↦ hmem ⟨⟨wt, hwt⟩, e.symm⟩),
        writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ r _ w hmem, writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ r _ w hmem]

theorem stOfCT_xorStrict7_cancel {n : ℕ} (r : QRegister 118 n)

    (idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ) (cols : CT) (wt : ℕ) (hwt : wt < 118) (mask : ℕ)
        (δ : BitAssignment n) :

  funext w

  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hmem
    rw [stOfCT_reg, stOfCT_reg, xorStrict7_testBit _ u.val wt mask (idxOf δ) u.isLt hwt,
        xorStrict7_testBit cols u.val wt mask (idxOf δ) u.isLt hwt]

  · dsimp only [stOfCT]
    rw [writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ r _ w hmem, writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ r _ w hmem]

theorem step_andC118 {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {W n : ℕ} [NeZero (2 ^ n)]

      (mkKetOpW rWork (stOfCT r st0 idxOf (xorStrict 7 cols w3 (getCT 7 cols w1 &&& getCT 7 cols

      (.circuit (andComputeCircuit (r ⟨w1, hw.1⟩) (r ⟨w2, hw.2.1⟩) (r ⟨w3, hw.2.2.1⟩)
        (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne hw.2.2.2.1))

      (r ⟨w3, hw.2.2.1⟩)
    (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne hw.2.2.2.1))

    (r.wires.injective.ne (Fin.ne_of_val_ne hw.2.2.2.2.2)))

      (by rw [stOfCT_reg, stOfCT_reg, hz3, Nat.zero_testBit, Bool.false_xor, Nat.testBit_and,

theorem step_andR118 {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {W n : ℕ} [NeZero (2 ^ n)]
    (v : Var) (rWork : QRegister W n) (r : QRegister 118 n)
    (st0 : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n) (ph : BitAssignment n → ZMod 2)
    (idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ)
    (cols : CT) (w1 w2 w3 : ℕ)
    (hw : w1 < 118 ∧ w2 < 118 ∧ w3 < 118 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧ w1 ≠ w3 ∧ w2 ≠ w3)

theorem norm_laurent_tail_of_halfplane {d L : ℕ} {s u_bound fin_bound tail_bound eps_tail : ℝ}
    {z : ℂ} (hdL : d + L ≤ kapteynTruncD) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hu_le : ∀ {u : ℂ}, ‖u‖ = 1 → u.im ≤ 0 →
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n * u ^ n‖ ≤ u_bound)
    (hfin_le : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), ‖jacobiAngerTruncCoeff kapteynTruncD s n‖ ≤
    fin_bound) (htail_le : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + L + 1) kapteynTruncD,
    ‖jacobiAngerTruncCoeff kapteynTruncD s n‖ ≤ tail_bound)
    (hsum : u_bound + fin_bound / 2 + tail_bound ≤ eps_tail) : ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d +
    1) kapteynTruncD, jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n * (z ^ n + conj z ^ n)‖ ≤
    eps_tail := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu_norm, hv_norm, hu_im, huv_pow⟩ : ∃ u v : ℂ,
      ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ u.im ≤ 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, z ^ n + conj z ^ n = u ^ n + v ^ n := by
    by_cases hzim : z.im ≤ 0
    · exact ⟨z, conj z, hz, (RCLike.norm_conj z).trans hz, hzim, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨conj z, z, (RCLike.norm_conj z).trans hz, hz,
        (Complex.conj_im z).trans_le (by linarith), fun _ ↦ add_comm _ _⟩
  have hunion : Finset.Icc (d + 1) kapteynTruncD =
      Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L) ∪ Finset.Icc (d + L + 1) kapteynTruncD :=
    Finset.ext fun n ↦ by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_union]; omega
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L)) (Finset.Icc (d + L + 1) kapteynTruncD) :=
    Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun n h1 h2 ↦ by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at h1 h2; omega
  simp_rw [huv_pow]
  rw [hunion, Finset.sum_union hdisj,
    show (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n *
        (u ^ n + v ^ n)) =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n * u ^ n) +
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n * v ^ n) by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ mul_add _ _ _, add_assoc]
  have hb2 : ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n * v ^ n‖ ≤
      fin_bound / 2 := by
    have hpt : (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1) (d + L), ‖jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n *
        v ^ n‖) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + 1)
            (d + L), ‖jacobiAngerTruncCoeff kapteynTruncD s n‖ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
      have hn1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      simp only [jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, hv_norm, one_pow, mul_one, show ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) by norm_num]
    have hm := (norm_sum_le _ _).trans_eq hpt
    linarith
  have hb3 : ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (d + L + 1) kapteynTruncD,
      jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff kapteynTruncD s n * (u ^ n + v ^ n)‖ ≤ tail_bound :=
    (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ((Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn ↦ by
      have hn1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      simp only [jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff]
      have h2 : ‖u ^ (m + 1) + v ^ (m + 1)‖ ≤ 2 := by
        have hadd := norm_add_le (u ^ (m + 1)) (v ^ (m + 1))
        rw [norm_pow, norm_pow, hu_norm, hv_norm, one_pow] at hadd
        linarith
      rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, norm_mul, show ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      have h1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg (jacobiAngerTruncCoeff kapteynTruncD s (m + 1)))
      linarith).trans htail_le)
  exact ((norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hu_le hu_norm hu_im)
    ((norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hb2 hb3)))).trans (by linarith)
end ScalarHalfPlaneCauchy

theorem poly_norm_eval_truncLaurentPoly_half_le {K D : ℕ} {s ε_tail ε_rem ε_cheb : ℝ} {z : ℂ}

    ‖(truncLaurentPoly K D s).eval z‖ ≤ 1 + ε_cheb := by

  rw [norm_eval_laurentPoly_of_norm_eq_one K _ hz]
  have hfull := norm_eval_jacobiAngerLaurentPoly_le D hs0 hz
  rw [jacobiAngerLaurentPoly, norm_eval_laurentPoly_of_norm_eq_one D _ hz] at hfull

theorem chebyshevT_conj_diagonal_pair {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    {U : Matrix I I ℂ} (hU1 : Uᴴ * U = 1) (hU2 : U * Uᴴ = 1) (d : I → ℂ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      chebyshevT k ((U * Matrix.diagonal d) * Uᴴ) =
        (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ chebScalarC k (d i))) * Uᴴ ∧
      chebyshevT (k + 1) ((U * Matrix.diagonal d) * Uᴴ) =
        (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i))) * Uᴴ
  | 0 => by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [chebyshevT, chebScalarC, Matrix.diagonal_one, hU2]
      · simp [chebyshevT, chebScalarC]
  | k + 1 => by
      obtain ⟨ih0, ih1⟩ :=
          chebyshevT_conj_diagonal_pair hU1 hU2 d k; refine ⟨ih1, ?_⟩; rw [chebyshevT_add_two, ih1,
          ih0]
      have hmul : ((U * Matrix.diagonal d) * Uᴴ) *
          ((U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i))) * Uᴴ) =
          (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ d i * chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i))) * Uᴴ := by
        calc
          ((U * Matrix.diagonal d) * Uᴴ) *
              ((U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i))) * Uᴴ)
              = U * Matrix.diagonal d * (Uᴴ * U) *
                  Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i)) * Uᴴ := by
                simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          _ = U * (Matrix.diagonal d *
                Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i))) * Uᴴ := by
                rw [hU1, Matrix.mul_one]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          _ = (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ d i * chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i))) * Uᴴ := by
            rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
      rw [hmul]
      have hstep : (fun i ↦ chebScalarC (k + 2) (d i)) = (fun i ↦ (2 : ℂ) *
          (d i * chebScalarC (k + 1) (d i)) - chebScalarC k (d i))
          := by funext i; simp only [chebScalarC]; ring
      rw [hstep]; ext i j;
      simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
          Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc,
          mul_left_comm]
theorem sum_smul_conj_diagonal {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (U : Matrix I I ℂ)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (f : ℕ → I → ℂ) : (∑ k ∈ S, c k • ((U * Matrix.diagonal (f k)) *
    Uᴴ)) = (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ ∑ k ∈ S, c k * f k i)) * Uᴴ := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      have h0 : Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : I ↦ (0 : ℂ)) = 0 := Matrix.diagonal_zero
      simp [h0]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, ih]; ext i j;
      simp [Finset.sum_insert ha, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
          Matrix.diagonal_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add,
          add_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
theorem poly_opNorm_truncChebApprox_sub_exp_half_le {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    {K D : ℕ} {H : Matrix I I ℂ} {s ε_tail ε_rem ε_cheb : ℝ} (hKD : K ≤ D) (hH : Hᴴ = H)
    (hnorm : ‖H‖ ≤ 1) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hε_tail0 : 0 ≤ ε_tail) (htail_circle : ∀ {z : ℂ}, ‖z‖ = 1 →
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (K + 1) D, jacobiAngerLaurentCoeff D s k * (z ^ k + conj z ^ k)‖ ≤ ε_tail)
    (hrem : s ^ (D + 1) / ((D + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤ ε_rem) (hsum : ε_rem + ε_tail ≤ ε_cheb) :
    ‖truncChebApprox K D H s - NormedSpace.exp ((-Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) • H)‖ ≤ ε_cheb := by
  have hsplit_sum : chebyshevPolyApprox H D s - truncChebApprox K D H s =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (K + 1) D, jacobiAngerTruncCoeff D s k • chebyshevT k H := by
    unfold chebyshevPolyApprox truncChebApprox
    rw [show Finset.range (D + 1) = Finset.range (K + 1) ∪ Finset.Icc (K + 1) D from
        Finset.ext fun k ↦ by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega,
      Finset.sum_union (Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun k h1 h2 ↦ by
        simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Icc] at h1 h2; omega)]
    abel
  have him : IsHermitian H := hH
  set U := him.eigenvectorUnitary.1
  set ev := him.eigenvalues
  have hdiag : H = (U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (ev i : ℂ))) * Uᴴ := by
    simpa [U, ev, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, Function.comp_def,
      Matrix.mul_assoc] using him.spectral_theorem

        rw [hdiag]

        exact mul_le_mul h1 hunit (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg g))).trans_eq (mul_one _)

    {R₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ} {Rs : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)} {Q : Polynomial ℂ}
    (hR₀ : R₀ ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) (hRs : ∀ R ∈ Rs, R ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)

    let +nondep : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Operator (2 ^ systemQubits_frozen)) :=
        .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ (Operator (2 ^ systemQubits_frozen))

          (scaleTimeShared D : ℂ)) • D.aImpl))) *
      (locAncGen ancW).basisOutcomeProjector 0‖ ≤ ε_clean := by

  have : NeZero (2 ^ (systemQubits_frozen + ancW)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero⟩

      (mem_cons_bidirLayers_unitary hR₀ hRs)) (e_mem_unitary (eQGen hAnc) eQGen_star hadamard2_mem)⟩

      ⟨NormedSpace.exp ((-Complex.I * (scaleTimeShared D : ℂ)) • D.aImpl),

      rw [skewAdjoint.mem_iff, star_smul, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, D.aImpl_herm, star_mul',
          Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, map_neg, Complex.conj_I]
      ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring)⟩
  have hexact_corner : P₀ * U_exact.1 * P₀ =

          δ) : ℝ) :

          (scaleTimeShared D)) * P₀) := by
    have hsub : eQGen hAnc (Matrix.single 0 0 1) =

        by omega⟩)).basisOutcomeProjector 0 := by
      rw [show Matrix.single (0 : Fin 2) 0 (1 : ℂ) =

      rfl

      rw [hsub]
      exact QRegExt.basisOutcomeProjector_compose_mul_zero (locAncGen ancW)
          (QRegister.singleton ⟨ancW - 1, by omega⟩)
    exact walk_corner_screened_poly (locSysGen ancW) P₀ (eQGen hAnc (Matrix.single 0 0 1))
      (lcuProjGen D.lcuSub) (projScrGen D) D.S.1 U_exact.1 D.aImpl
      ((locAncGen ancW).basisOutcomeProjector_mul_self 0)
      (((locAncGen ancW).compose D.lcuSub).basisOutcomeProjector_conjTranspose 0)
      (((locAncGen ancW).compose D.lcuSub).basisOutcomeProjector_mul_self 0)
      (((locAncGen ancW).compose D.scrSub).basisOutcomeProjector_conjTranspose 0)
      (((locAncGen ancW).compose D.scrSub).basisOutcomeProjector_mul_self 0)
      (((locAncGen ancW).compose D.lcuSub).embedMatrix_comm_of_disjoint _
        (disj_lcu_scrGen D) (compProj 0) (compProj 0)).symm
      hsub0 hsub1
      (QRegExt.basisOutcomeProjector_zero_mul_compose (locAncGen ancW) D.lcuSub)
      (QRegExt.basisOutcomeProjector_compose_mul_zero (locAncGen ancW) D.lcuSub)
      (QRegExt.basisOutcomeProjector_zero_mul_compose (locAncGen ancW) D.scrSub)
      (QRegExt.basisOutcomeProjector_compose_mul_zero (locAncGen ancW) D.scrSub)
      (S_mul_self_eq_oneGen D) D.S_herm D.S_scr.eq D.hblock D.aImpl_herm
      ((locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix_comm_of_disjoint _ (disj_locSysGen_lcu D) D.aImpl (compProj 0))
      ((locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix_comm_of_disjoint _ (disj_locSysGen_scr D) D.aImpl (compProj 0))

  have hε_blk0 : 0 ≤ cw.ε_block := by linarith [cw.hε_cheb0, cw.hδ_pos, cw.hblock_sum]
  have hja_block : ‖P₀ * (U_exact.1 - (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff.1) * P₀‖ ≤ cw.ε_block := by
    rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, hexact_corner, show P₀ * (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff.1 * P₀ =
        (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff.1 * P₀ by
      dsimp only [P₀, QRegister.basisOutcomeProjector]
      rw [← ((locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix_comm_of_disjoint (locAncGen ancW) disj_locSysGen_locAncGen

          mul_assoc, ← (locAncGen ancW).embedMatrix_mul, compProj_mul_self],

    have hscaled :

        δ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • truncChebApprox d kapteynTruncD D.aImpl (scaleTimeShared D) - U_eff.1‖ ≤
        cw.ε_block :=
      (norm_scaled_approx_sub_target_le cw.hε_cheb0 cw.hδ_pos (QubitizationTop.norm_unitary_le_one
          U_eff)
        (poly_opNorm_truncChebApprox_sub_exp_half_le cw.hd_le D.aImpl_herm D.aImpl_norm hs0

          (fun hz ↦ cw.htail_circle hs0 hs_le hz)

    exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans ((mul_le_mul ((QubitizationTop.opNorm_embedMatrix_le (locSysGen
        ancW) _).trans hscaled)
      (norm_basisOutcomeProjector_zero_le_one (locAncGen ancW))
          (norm_nonneg _) hε_blk0).trans (mul_one _).le)
  exact (opNorm_cleanAncilla_le_sqrt_two_mul_block_error U_exact U_eff hε_blk0 hja_block).trans

theorem approximatesTimeEvolution_of_cleanWalkCertHalf_topPhase
    {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {ancW n d tSel : ℕ} {hAnc : 100 ≤ ancW}
    {rSys : QRegister systemQubits_frozen n} {rAnc : QRegister ancW n}

    (hs_le : scaleTimeShared D ≤ sMax)

    (M_dyad : Operator (2 ^ (systemQubits_frozen + ancW)))

      hadamard2.map Polynomial.C) *ᵥ
      Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 0 Matrix.vecEmpty) =
      Matrix.vecCons
        (Polynomial.X * scaledPoly cw.ε_cheb δ
          (truncLaurentPoly d kapteynTruncD (scaleTimeShared D)))
        (Matrix.vecCons Q Matrix.vecEmpty))
    (hcat : ‖(W.1 - M_dyad) * (locAncGen ancW).basisOutcomeProjector 0‖ ≤ ε_cat)
    (hdyad : ‖(gqspOp (eQGen hAnc) (walkOpShared D) ((hadamard2, false) :: bidirLayers R₀ Rs) *
        eQGen hAnc hadamard2) -
        Complex.exp (Γ * Complex.I) • (eQGen hAnc (phaseTurn g_top) * M_dyad)‖ ≤ ε_dyad)

    ApproximatesTimeEvolution (k := systemQubits_frozen) (m := ancW) D.aImpl

      gqspOp (eQGen hAnc) (walkOpShared D) ((hadamard2, false) :: bidirLayers R₀ Rs) *
      eQGen hAnc hadamard2
  let +nondep : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Operator (2 ^ systemQubits_frozen)) :=
      .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ (Operator (2 ^ systemQubits_frozen))

  have hclean : ‖(U_exact_op - (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff_op) * P₀‖ ≤ ε_clean :=

    rw [← map_mul, ← star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem (phaseTurn_mem g_top),

            (QRegister.singleton ⟨ancW - 1, by omega⟩)).basisOutcomeProjector 0 by
        rw [show Matrix.single (0 : Fin 2) 0 (1 : ℂ) = compProj 0 by

        rfl]
      exact QRegExt.basisOutcomeProjector_compose_mul_zero (locAncGen ancW) _
    conv_lhs => rw [← hP0_proj]

    rw [show (U_rot_op - (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff_op) * P₀ = Φinv *

      dsimp only [U_rot_op]
      calc (Φinv * U_exact_op - (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff_op) * P₀

    exact ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul hΦinv_norm hclean (norm_nonneg _)

  have hdyad_rot_op : ‖U_rot_op - Complex.exp (Γ * Complex.I) • M_dyad‖ ≤ ε_dyad := by
    rw [show U_rot_op - Complex.exp (Γ * Complex.I) • M_dyad = Φinv * (U_exact_op - Complex.exp (Γ *
        Complex.I) • (Φ * M_dyad)) by
      dsimp only [U_rot_op]

    exact ((norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul hΦinv_norm hdyad (norm_nonneg _)

  have hdyad_rot : ‖(M_dyad - Complex.exp ((-Γ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • U_rot_op) * P₀‖ ≤ ε_dyad := by
    have hneg : Complex.exp ((-Γ : ℝ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (Γ * Complex.I) = 1 := by

    rw [show M_dyad - Complex.exp ((-Γ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • U_rot_op = -(Complex.exp ((-Γ : ℝ) *

  change ‖(W.1 - Complex.exp ((-Γ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • (locSysGen ancW).embedMatrix U_eff_op) * P₀‖ ≤
