    rw [show ∑ i : Fin 3, p i * Real.exp (μ * chordalY (W i * P)) = Real.exp (μ * chordalY P) *
        ∑ i : Fin 3, p i * Real.exp (μ * xStep i) by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [show chordalY (W i * P) = chordalY P + xStep i by
        unfold chordalY
        dsimp only [xStep]
        rw [sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.sub_apply, Complex.sub_re]
        ring, mul_add, Real.exp_add]
      ring, add_assoc, Real.exp_add]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hoeffding_fin3_mgf hp0 hpsum
        (by dsimp [R, B_quad, A_lin, sY]; positivity) hpair_X hμ_pos.le) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hR_sq : R ^ 2 ≤ 1001 * B_quad ^ 2 + (1001 / 1000 : ℝ) * (A_lin ^ 2 * (2 * chordalY P)) := by
    have hyoung : (B_quad + A_lin * sY) ^ 2 ≤ 1001 * B_quad ^ 2 + (1001 / 1000 : ℝ) *
        (A_lin * sY) ^ 2 :=
      sub_nonneg.mp (by
        rw [show 1001 * B_quad ^ 2 + (1001 / 1000 : ℝ) * (A_lin * sY) ^ 2 - (B_quad + A_lin *
            sY) ^ 2 =
          (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * (1000 * B_quad - A_lin * sY) ^ 2 by ring]
        exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sq_nonneg _))
    have hsY_sq : (A_lin * sY) ^ 2 = A_lin ^ 2 * (2 * chordalY P) := by
      dsimp only [sY]
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [hsY_sq] at hyoung
    exact hyoung
  have hc1 : (1001 / 1000 : ℝ) * A_lin ^ 2 / 4 ≤ c := by
    dsimp only [A_lin, c, simpStepC]
    norm_num
  have hc2 : 35304 / 10 ^ 18 + (1 / simpU0) * ((1001 / 8 : ℝ) * B_quad ^ 2) ≤ (27 / 40 : ℝ) *
      c := by
    dsimp only [B_quad, simpU0, c, simpStepC]
    norm_num
  have hμ_le_u0 : μ ≤ 1 / simpU0 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hu0_pos (by dsimp [u']; linarith)
  have hμ2_le : μ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (u_prev * u') := by
    rw [show μ ^ 2 = 1 / u' ^ 2 by dsimp [μ]; rw [div_pow, one_pow]]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (mul_pos hup_pos hu'_pos)
        (by nlinarith [show u_prev ≤ u' by dsimp [u']; linarith])
  have hquad_term : (μ * R) ^ 2 / 8 ≤ μ ^ 2 * ((1001 / 8 : ℝ) * B_quad ^ 2) + μ ^ 2 *
      ((1001 / 1000 : ℝ) * A_lin ^ 2 / 4) * chordalY P := by
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR_sq (by positivity : 0 ≤ μ ^ 2 / 8)]
  have hconst_part : μ * (∑ i : Fin 3, p i * xStep i) + μ ^ 2 * ((1001 / 8 : ℝ) * B_quad ^ 2) ≤
      (27 / 40 : ℝ) * (μ * c) := by
    have hinner : ∑ i : Fin 3, p i * xStep i + μ * ((1001 / 8 : ℝ) * B_quad ^ 2) ≤ (27 / 40 : ℝ) *
        c := by
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hμ_le_u0
          (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1001 / 8 : ℝ) * B_quad ^ 2)]
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner hμ_pos.le]
  have hlin_part : μ * chordalY P + μ ^ 2 * ((1001 / 1000 : ℝ) * A_lin ^ 2 / 4) * chordalY P ≤
      (1 / u_prev) * chordalY P := by
    have hcoef : μ + μ ^ 2 * ((1001 / 1000 : ℝ) * A_lin ^ 2 / 4) ≤ 1 / u_prev := by
      have hident : μ + (1 / (u_prev * u')) * c = 1 / u_prev := by
        dsimp only [μ, u']
        field_simp [hu'_pos.ne', hup_pos.ne']
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc1 (sq_nonneg μ),
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hμ2_le hc_pos.le]
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hYP_nn]
  exact (hstep1.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))).trans_eq (Real.exp_add _ _)

theorem simplicial_riccati_step {capStep : ℕ} (hStep : ∀ U ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ,
    Nonempty (SimpStepSpecCapEp capStep 460 35304 U)) {M : ℕ} {θ_fn : Fin M → ℝ}
    {E D : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ} {γ u_prev B40 : ℝ} (hC : ChainSU2R E D γ)
    (hup : simpU0 ≤ u_prev) (hPot : (mgfPot M u_prev (fun j ↦ E (θ_fn j))
    (fun j ↦ D (θ_fn j)) γ) ^ 40 ≤ B40) {U : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ}
    (hU : U ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) : ∃ (c : Circuit 1) (g' γ' : ℝ),
        (CircExt.isOneQubitCircuit c) = true ∧
    c.count PrimitiveGate.T ≤ capStep ∧ c.count PrimitiveGate.TOFF = 0 ∧ ChainSU2R (fun θ ↦ U * E θ)
    (fun θ ↦ phaseTurn g' * (c.eval.1 * D θ)) γ' ∧ (mgfPot M (u_prev + simpStepC)
    (fun j ↦ U * E (θ_fn j)) (fun j ↦ phaseTurn g' * (c.eval.1 * D (θ_fn j))) γ') ^ 40 ≤
    (((u_prev + simpStepC) / u_prev) ^ 27) * B40 := by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := hStep U hU
  have hup_pos : 0 < u_prev := lt_of_lt_of_le simpU0_pos hup
  let W : Fin 3 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun i ↦
    ((Complex.exp ((S.γ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) • phaseTurn (S.g i)) * (S.circ i).eval.1) * Uᴴ
  obtain ⟨hU1U, hW_su2, hW_err, hW_pair, hW_mean⟩ := simpStep_W_bounds hU S
  let Q : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun θ ↦
    (Complex.exp (((γ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) • D θ) * (E θ)ᴴ
  let Qconj : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun θ ↦ U * Q θ * Uᴴ
  have hQconj (θ : ℝ) : IsSU2 (Qconj θ) ∧ chordalY (Qconj θ) = chordalY (Q θ) :=
    isSU2_conj_unitary hU (hC θ).2.2
  have hprod_i (i : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ) :
      (Complex.exp ((((γ + S.γ i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) •
        (phaseTurn (S.g i) * ((S.circ i).eval.1 * D θ))) * (U * E θ)ᴴ = W i * Qconj θ := by
    dsimp only [W, Qconj, Q]
    rw [show Complex.exp ((((γ + S.γ i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        Complex.exp ((S.γ i : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (((γ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      exact congrArg Complex.exp (by push_cast; ring), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hmid : (S.circ i).eval.1 * D θ * (E θ)ᴴ * Uᴴ =
        (S.circ i).eval.1 * (Uᴴ * U) * D θ * (E θ)ᴴ * Uᴴ := by rw [hU1U, Matrix.mul_one]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc] at hmid ⊢
    rw [hmid]
    congr 1
    exact mul_comm _ _
  let Pot : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun i ↦ mgfPot M (u_prev + simpStepC) (fun j ↦ U * E (θ_fn j))
    (fun j ↦ phaseTurn (S.g i) * ((S.circ i).eval.1 * D (θ_fn j))) (γ + S.γ i)
  set x_step : ℝ := (1 / (u_prev + simpStepC)) * simpStepC
  let Pot_prev : ℝ := mgfPot M u_prev (fun j ↦ E (θ_fn j)) (fun j ↦ D (θ_fn j)) γ
  have havg : ∑ i : Fin 3, S.p i * Pot i ≤ Real.exp ((27 / 40 : ℝ) * x_step) * Pot_prev := by
    rw [show ∑ i : Fin 3, S.p i * Pot i = ∑ j : Fin M, ∑ i : Fin 3, S.p i *
        Real.exp ((1 / (u_prev + simpStepC)) * chordalY (W i * Qconj (θ_fn j))) by
      rw [← Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      dsimp only [Pot, mgfPot]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by rw [hprod_i i (θ_fn j)],
      show Real.exp ((27 / 40 : ℝ) * x_step) * Pot_prev =
        ∑ j : Fin M, Real.exp ((27 / 40 : ℝ) * x_step) *
          Real.exp ((1 / u_prev) * chordalY (Q (θ_fn j))) from Finset.mul_sum _ _ _]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ by
      simpa only [(hQconj (θ_fn j)).2] using simplicial_mgf_fiber_step
        (hQconj (θ_fn j)).1 hup S.hp_nn S.hp_sum hW_su2 hW_err hW_pair hW_mean
  obtain ⟨i_min, hmin_mem⟩ := exists_min_fin3 Pot
  have hpow40 : (Pot i_min) ^ 40 ≤ (((u_prev + simpStepC) / u_prev) ^ 27) * B40 := by
    have hmin_lin : Pot i_min ≤ Real.exp ((27 / 40 : ℝ) * x_step) * Pot_prev :=
      (show Pot i_min ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, S.p i * Pot i by
        rw [← one_mul (Pot i_min), ← S.hp_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmin_mem i) (S.hp_nn i)).trans
        havg
    refine ((pow_le_pow_left₀ (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      hmin_lin 40).trans_eq (show _ = (Real.exp x_step) ^ 27 * Pot_prev ^ 40 by
        rw [mul_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        exact congrArg (· * Pot_prev ^ 40) (congrArg Real.exp (by push_cast; ring)))).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos _).le (exp_mul_le_ratio hup_pos simpStepC_pos.le) 27)
      hPot (pow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ (Real.exp_pos _).le) 40)
      (pow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith [simpStepC_pos]) hup_pos.le) 27)
  exact ⟨S.circ i_min, S.g i_min, γ + S.γ i_min, S.hcirc_1q i_min, S.hcirc_T i_min,
    S.hcirc_toff i_min, fun θ ↦ ⟨mul_mem hU (hC θ).1,
      mul_mem (phaseTurn_mem _) (mul_mem (S.circ i_min).eval.2 (hC θ).2.1),
      hprod_i i_min θ ▸ isSU2_mul (hW_su2 i_min) (hQconj θ).1⟩, hpow40⟩

theorem simplicial_riccati_chain_list {capStep : ℕ}
    (hStep : ∀ U ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ, Nonempty (SimpStepSpecCapEp capStep 460 35304 U))
    {M : ℕ} (θ_fn : Fin M → ℝ)
    {R₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ} (hR₀ : R₀ ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ∀ (Rs : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) {m : ℕ},
      (∀ R ∈ Rs, R ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ) → Rs.length = m →
      ∃ (c₀ : Circuit 1) (stepC : Fin m → Circuit 1) (g_prev γ : ℝ),
        (CircExt.isOneQubitCircuit c₀) = true ∧ c₀.count PrimitiveGate.T ≤ capStep ∧
            c₀.count PrimitiveGate.TOFF = 0 ∧
        (∀ s : Fin m, (CircExt.isOneQubitCircuit (stepC s)) = true ∧
          (stepC s).count PrimitiveGate.T ≤ capStep ∧ (stepC s).count PrimitiveGate.TOFF = 0) ∧
        ChainSU2R
          (fun θ ↦ gqspOp idE (scalarWalk θ) (bidirLayers R₀ Rs))
          (fun θ ↦ phaseTurn g_prev *
            simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC) γ ∧
        (mgfPot M (simpU0 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * simpStepC)
          (fun j ↦ gqspOp idE (scalarWalk (θ_fn j)) (bidirLayers R₀ Rs))
          (fun j ↦ phaseTurn g_prev *
            simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk (θ_fn j)) c₀ stepC) γ) ^ 40 ≤
          (((simpU0 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * simpStepC) / simpU0) ^ 27) * ((M : ℝ) ^ 40)
  | [], 0, _, _ => by
      let E₀ : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun θ ↦ sigOp idE (scalarWalk θ) true
      have hE₀_mem (θ : ℝ) : E₀ θ ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ :=
        sigOp_mem_unitary idE (fun _ ↦ rfl) (scalarWalk_mem_unitary θ)
          (scalarWalk_mem_commutant θ) true
      have hQ₀_one (θ : ℝ) : (Complex.exp (((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) • E₀ θ) * (E₀ θ)ᴴ = 1 := by
        simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero, one_smul] using
          mem_u2_mul_conj (hE₀_mem θ)
      have hPot₀ : (mgfPot M simpU0 (fun j ↦ E₀ (θ_fn j)) (fun j ↦ E₀ (θ_fn j)) 0) ^ 40 ≤
          (M : ℝ) ^ 40 := by
        unfold mgfPot
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by
          rw [hQ₀_one (θ_fn j), chordalY_one, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]]
        simp
      obtain ⟨c₀, g_prev, γ, hc1, hcT, hcF, hC₁, hPot₁⟩ := simplicial_riccati_step hStep
        (fun θ ↦ ⟨hE₀_mem θ, hE₀_mem θ, (hQ₀_one θ).symm ▸ isSU2_one⟩) le_rfl hPot₀ hR₀
      refine ⟨c₀, Fin.elim0, g_prev, γ, hc1, hcT, hcF, fun s ↦ Fin.elim0 s, by
        simpa only [gqspOp_bidirLayers_nil, simpFusedChainOfCircuits, idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]
          using hC₁, ?_⟩
      rw [show simpU0 + ((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * simpStepC = simpU0 + simpStepC by
        norm_num]
      simpa only [gqspOp_bidirLayers_nil, simpFusedChainOfCircuits, idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]
        using hPot₁
  | [], _ + 1, _, hlen => by simp at hlen
  | _ :: _, 0, _, hlen => by simp at hlen
  | R :: Rs, m + 1, hRs_all, hlen => by
      have hu0_pos : 0 < simpU0 := simpU0_pos
      have hR : R ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ := hRs_all R List.mem_cons_self
      obtain ⟨c₀, stepC, g_prev, γ_m, hc0_1, hc0_T, hc0_F, hstep_props, hC_m, hPot_m⟩ :=
        simplicial_riccati_chain_list hStep θ_fn hR₀ Rs
          (fun R' hR' ↦ hRs_all R' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hR')) (Nat.succ.inj hlen)
      set u_m : ℝ := simpU0 + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * simpStepC
      have hum_ge : simpU0 ≤ u_m := by
        linarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * simpStepC from
          mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) simpStepC_pos.le]
      have hum_pos : 0 < u_m := lt_of_lt_of_le hu0_pos hum_ge
      let S : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun θ ↦
        sigOp idE (scalarWalk θ) false * sigOp idE (scalarWalk θ) true
      have hS_mem (θ : ℝ) : S θ ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ := mul_mem
        (sigOp_mem_unitary idE (fun _ ↦ rfl) (scalarWalk_mem_unitary θ)
          (scalarWalk_mem_commutant θ) false)
        (sigOp_mem_unitary idE (fun _ ↦ rfl) (scalarWalk_mem_unitary θ)
          (scalarWalk_mem_commutant θ) true)
      let V_step : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := fun θ ↦ (phaseTurn g_prev)ᴴ * S θ
      obtain ⟨hC_S, hPot_S⟩ := chain_left_mul_unitaryR (V := V_step) (θ_fn := θ_fn) (u := u_m) hC_m
        (fun θ ↦ mul_mem (mem_u2_conj (phaseTurn_mem g_prev)) (hS_mem θ))
      have hS_comm (θ : ℝ) : S θ * phaseTurn g_prev = phaseTurn g_prev * S θ := by
        dsimp only [S]
        have hcF := comm_phaseTurn_sigOp idE (scalarWalk_mem_commutant θ)
          (scalarWalk_conj_mem_commutant θ) g_prev false
        have hcT := comm_phaseTurn_sigOp idE (scalarWalk_mem_commutant θ)
          (scalarWalk_conj_mem_commutant θ) g_prev true
        simp only [idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq] at hcF hcT
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hcT, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hcF, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      have hVD_eq (θ : ℝ) : V_step θ *
          (phaseTurn g_prev * simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC) =
          S θ * simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC := by
        dsimp only [V_step]
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (S θ), hS_comm θ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
          ← Matrix.mul_assoc, mem_u2_conj_mul (phaseTurn_mem g_prev), Matrix.one_mul]
      have hC_S' : ChainSU2R (fun θ ↦ V_step θ * gqspOp idE (scalarWalk θ) (bidirLayers R₀ Rs))
          (fun θ ↦ S θ * simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC) γ_m := by
        simpa only [hVD_eq] using hC_S
      have hPot_S' : (mgfPot M u_m
          (fun j ↦ V_step (θ_fn j) * gqspOp idE (scalarWalk (θ_fn j)) (bidirLayers R₀ Rs))
          (fun j ↦ S (θ_fn j) * simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk (θ_fn j)) c₀ stepC)
          γ_m) ^ 40 ≤ ((u_m / simpU0) ^ 27) * ((M : ℝ) ^ 40) := by
        simpa only [hVD_eq] using (congrArg (· ^ 40) hPot_S).trans_le hPot_m
      obtain ⟨c_top, g_next, γ_next, hct_1, hct_T, hct_F, hC_next, hPot_next⟩ :=
        simplicial_riccati_step hStep hC_S' hum_ge hPot_S' (mul_mem hR (phaseTurn_mem g_prev))
      let stepC' : Fin (m + 1) → Circuit 1 := snocCircuits stepC c_top
      have hstep_props' (s : Fin (m + 1)) : (CircExt.isOneQubitCircuit (stepC' s)) = true ∧
          (stepC' s).count PrimitiveGate.T ≤ capStep ∧ (stepC' s).count PrimitiveGate.TOFF = 0 := by
        dsimp only [stepC', snocCircuits]
        split_ifs with hs
        · exact hstep_props ⟨s.val, hs⟩
        · exact ⟨hct_1, hct_T, hct_F⟩
      have hexact_eq (θ : ℝ) : (R * phaseTurn g_prev) *
          (V_step θ * gqspOp idE (scalarWalk θ) (bidirLayers R₀ Rs)) =
          gqspOp idE (scalarWalk θ) (bidirLayers R₀ (R :: Rs)) := by
        dsimp only [V_step, S]
        rw [gqspOp_bidirLayers_cons]
        simp only [idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc R (phaseTurn g_prev), mem_u2_mul_conj (phaseTurn_mem g_prev),
          Matrix.mul_one]
      have hsimp_eq (θ : ℝ) : phaseTurn g_next *
          (c_top.eval.1 * (S θ * simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC)) =
          phaseTurn g_next * simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC' := by
        dsimp only [simpFusedChainOfCircuits, stepC', S, idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]
        rw [snocCircuits_last, show (fun i ↦ snocCircuits stepC c_top (Fin.castSucc i)) = stepC from
          funext (snocCircuits_castSucc stepC c_top)]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      have hu_eq : simpU0 + ((m + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * simpStepC = u_m + simpStepC := by
        dsimp only [u_m]
        push_cast
        ring
      refine ⟨c₀, stepC', g_next, γ_next, hc0_1, hc0_T, hc0_F, hstep_props',
        by simpa only [hexact_eq, hsimp_eq] using hC_next, ?_⟩
      conv_lhs => rw [hu_eq]
      refine (show (mgfPot M (u_m + simpStepC) _ _ γ_next) ^ 40 ≤ _ by
        simpa only [hexact_eq, hsimp_eq] using hPot_next).trans_eq ?_
      rw [hu_eq, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, show ((u_m + simpStepC) / u_m) * (u_m / simpU0) =
        (u_m + simpStepC) / simpU0 by field_simp [hum_pos.ne', hu0_pos.ne']]

/-! ### 3. Laurent Representation & 28-Point `K = 100` Laplace Cluster MGF -/

noncomputable def unitCircleZ (φ : ℝ) : ℂ := Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
theorem unitCircleZ_mul_conj (φ : ℝ) : unitCircleZ φ * conj (unitCircleZ φ) = 1 := by
  dsimp [unitCircleZ]; rw [← Complex.exp_conj, ← Complex.exp_add]
  have hz : (φ : ℂ) * Complex.I + conj ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0 := by simp
  rw [hz, Complex.exp_zero]

noncomputable def evalConjTrig (P Q : ℂ[X]) (φ : ℝ) : ℂ :=
    P.eval (unitCircleZ φ) + conj (Q.eval (unitCircleZ φ))
theorem evalConjTrig_const (c : ℂ) : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ 0 ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ 0 ∧ ∀ φ : ℝ, c =
    evalConjTrig P Q φ :=
  ⟨Polynomial.C c, 0, (Polynomial.natDegree_C _).le, Polynomial.natDegree_zero.le,
    fun _ ↦ by simp [evalConjTrig]⟩

theorem evalConjTrig_add {m : ℕ} {f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℂ} (h₁ : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤
    m ∧ ∀ φ, f₁ φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ) (h₂ : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ φ,
    f₂ φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ) : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ φ, f₁ φ +
    f₂ φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ := by
  obtain ⟨P₁, Q₁, hP₁, hQ₁, hf₁⟩ := h₁; obtain ⟨P₂, Q₂, hP₂, hQ₂, hf₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨P₁ + P₂, Q₁ + Q₂, (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le hP₁ hP₂),
      (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le hQ₁ hQ₂), fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hf₁ φ, hf₂ φ]; simp only [evalConjTrig, Polynomial.eval_add, map_add]; ring
theorem evalConjTrig_const_mul {m : ℕ} (a : ℂ) {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧
    Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ φ, f φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ) : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤
    m ∧ ∀ φ, a * f φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ := by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hfeq⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨Polynomial.C a * P, Polynomial.C (conj a) * Q,
      (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le a P).trans hP,
      (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le (conj a) Q).trans hQ, fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hfeq φ];
  simp only [evalConjTrig, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, map_mul, Complex.conj_conj]; ring
theorem evalConjTrig_conj (P Q : ℂ[X]) (φ : ℝ) : conj (evalConjTrig P Q φ) =
    evalConjTrig Q P φ := by simp only [evalConjTrig, map_add, Complex.conj_conj]; ring
theorem evalConjTrig_mul_z {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤
    m ∧ ∀ φ, f φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ) : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m + 1 ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ m + 1 ∧
    ∀ φ, unitCircleZ φ * f φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ := by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hfeq⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨Polynomial.X * P + Polynomial.C (conj (Q.coeff 0)) * Polynomial.X, Q.divX,
    (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans (max_le
      (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans
        ((Nat.add_le_add (le_of_eq Polynomial.natDegree_X) hP).trans (by omega)))
      ((Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (by simp [Polynomial.natDegree_X]))),
    (le_of_eq Polynomial.natDegree_divX_eq_natDegree_tsub_one).trans (by omega), fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hQ0 : Q.eval (unitCircleZ φ) = unitCircleZ φ * Q.divX.eval (unitCircleZ φ) + Q.coeff 0 := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
      using congrArg (Polynomial.eval (unitCircleZ φ)) (Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add Q).symm
  rw [hfeq φ]
  dsimp only [evalConjTrig]
  rw [hQ0]
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  linear_combination conj (Q.divX.eval (unitCircleZ φ)) * unitCircleZ_mul_conj φ

theorem evalConjTrig_mul_conj_z {m : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧
    Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ φ, f φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ) : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m + 1 ∧
    Q.natDegree ≤ m + 1 ∧ ∀ φ, conj (unitCircleZ φ) * f φ = evalConjTrig P Q φ := by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hfeq⟩ := hf
  have hswap : ∃ P₀ Q₀ : ℂ[X], P₀.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q₀.natDegree ≤ m ∧
      ∀ φ, conj (f φ) = evalConjTrig P₀ Q₀ φ :=
    ⟨Q, P, hQ, hP, fun φ ↦ by rw [hfeq φ, evalConjTrig_conj]⟩
  obtain ⟨P₁, Q₁, hP₁, hQ₁, hmul⟩ := evalConjTrig_mul_z hswap
  refine ⟨Q₁, P₁, hQ₁, hP₁, fun φ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hc :=
      congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) (hmul φ); simpa only [map_mul, Complex.conj_conj,
      evalConjTrig_conj] using hc
theorem re_evalConjTrig (P Q : ℂ[X]) (φ : ℝ) : (evalConjTrig P Q φ).re = trigPolyRe (P + Q) φ := by
  simp only [evalConjTrig, trigPolyRe, unitCircleZ, Polynomial.eval_add, Complex.add_re,
      Complex.conj_re]
theorem su2Diag_neg_conjTranspose (θ : ℝ) : (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ = su2Diag θ := by
  rw [su2Diag_neg]; unfold su2Diag; ext i j : 1
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [← Complex.exp_conj]

theorem su2Diag_neg_conj_det (θ : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : (su2Diag (-θ) * M *
    (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ).det =
    M.det := by
  rw [su2Diag_neg_conjTranspose, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, mul_right_comm _ M.det _,
      ← Matrix.det_mul, su2Diag_neg_mul_self, Matrix.det_one, one_mul]
theorem su2Diag_neg_conj_entries (θ : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (su2Diag (-θ) * M * (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ) 0 0 = M 0 0 ∧
    (su2Diag (-θ) * M * (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ) 1 1 = M 1 1 ∧
    (su2Diag (-θ) * M * (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ) 0 1 = unitCircleZ (2 * θ) * M 0 1 ∧
    (su2Diag (-θ) * M * (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ) 1 0 = conj (unitCircleZ (2 * θ)) * M 1 0 := by
  rw [su2Diag_neg_conjTranspose, su2Diag_neg]
  unfold su2Diag unitCircleZ
  have h1 : Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp (-((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 1 :=
    (Complex.exp_add _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg Complex.exp (by ring)).trans Complex.exp_zero)
  have hpos2 : Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      Complex.exp (((2 * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
    (Complex.exp_add _ _).symm.trans (congrArg Complex.exp (by push_cast; ring))
  have hneg2 : Complex.exp (-((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * Complex.exp (-((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      conj (Complex.exp (((2 * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
    exact congrArg Complex.exp (by push_cast; ring)
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
  exact ⟨by linear_combination M 0 0 * h1, by linear_combination M 1 1 * h1,
    by linear_combination M 0 1 * hpos2, by linear_combination M 1 0 * hneg2⟩

theorem evalConjTrig_mat_mul_left_right {m : ℕ} (L R : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (M : ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hM : ∀ r s : Fin 2, ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧
    Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ θ : ℝ, M θ r s = evalConjTrig P Q (2 * θ)) : ∀ r s : Fin 2, ∃ P Q : ℂ[X],
    P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ θ : ℝ, (L * M θ * R) r s = evalConjTrig P Q (2 * θ) := by
  intro r s
  choose Pm Qm hPm hQm hfeq using fun i j : Fin 2 ↦ hM i j
  have ht (i j : Fin 2) := evalConjTrig_const_mul (L r i * R j s)
    ⟨Pm i j, Qm i j, hPm i j, hQm i j, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Pa, Qa, hPa, hQa, hfa⟩ :=
      evalConjTrig_add (ht 0 0) (ht 0 1); obtain ⟨Pb, Qb, hPb, hQb, hfb⟩ :=
      evalConjTrig_add (ht 1 0) (ht 1 1); obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hf⟩ :=
      evalConjTrig_add ⟨Pa, Qa, hPa, hQa, hfa⟩ ⟨Pb, Qb, hPb, hQb, hfb⟩
  refine ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, fun θ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← hf (2 * θ)];
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, hfeq 0 0 θ, hfeq 0 1 θ, hfeq 1 0 θ, hfeq 1 1 θ];
  ring
noncomputable def simpChainCross (R₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (Rs : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) {m : ℕ} (c₀ : Circuit 1) (stepC : Fin m → Circuit 1)
    (θ : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    simpFusedChainOfCircuits idE (scalarWalk θ) c₀ stepC * (gqspOp idE (scalarWalk θ)
    (bidirLayers R₀ Rs))ᴴ
theorem simpChainCross_det_and_laurent (R₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (c₀ : Circuit 1) :
    ∀ (Rs : List (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) {m : ℕ} (stepC : Fin m → Circuit 1),
      Rs.length = m →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, (simpChainCross R₀ Rs c₀ stepC θ).det = (simpChainCross R₀ Rs c₀ stepC 0).det) ∧
      (∀ r s : Fin 2, ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ m ∧
        ∀ θ : ℝ, simpChainCross R₀ Rs c₀ stepC θ r s = evalConjTrig P Q (2 * θ))
  | [], 0, stepC, _ => by
      have hconst (θ : ℝ) : simpChainCross R₀ [] c₀ stepC θ = c₀.eval.1 * R₀ᴴ := by
        dsimp only [simpChainCross, simpFusedChainOfCircuits]
        rw [gqspOp_bidirLayers_nil]
        simp only [idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc c₀.eval.1, mem_u2_mul_conj (sigOp_mem_unitary idE (fun _ ↦ rfl)
          (scalarWalk_mem_unitary θ) (scalarWalk_mem_commutant θ) true), Matrix.mul_one]
      refine ⟨fun θ ↦ by rw [hconst θ, hconst 0], fun r s ↦ ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hc⟩ := evalConjTrig_const ((c₀.eval.1 * R₀ᴴ) r s)
      exact ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, fun θ ↦ (congrArg (fun M ↦ M r s) (hconst θ)).trans (hc (2 * θ))⟩
  | [], _ + 1, _, hlen => by simp at hlen
  | _ :: _, 0, _, hlen => by simp at hlen
  | R :: Rs, m + 1, stepC, hlen => by
      let stepC_init : Fin m → Circuit 1 := fun i ↦ stepC (Fin.castSucc i)
      obtain ⟨hdet_ih, hlaur_ih⟩ :=
          simpChainCross_det_and_laurent R₀ c₀ Rs stepC_init (Nat.succ.inj hlen)
      let U_top : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ := (stepC (Fin.last m)).eval.1
      have hrec : ∀ θ : ℝ, simpChainCross R₀ (R :: Rs) c₀ stepC θ =
          U_top * (su2Diag (-θ) * simpChainCross R₀ Rs c₀ stepC_init θ * (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ) * Rᴴ :=
              fun θ ↦ by
        dsimp only [simpChainCross, simpFusedChainOfCircuits, U_top, stepC_init]
        rw [gqspOp_bidirLayers_cons]
        simp only [idE, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, sigOp_scalarWalk_step_eq θ, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
            Matrix.mul_assoc]
      refine ⟨fun θ ↦ by
        rw [hrec θ, hrec 0, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, su2Diag_neg_conj_det,
          Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, su2Diag_neg_conj_det, hdet_ih θ], ?_⟩
      have hmid (r s : Fin 2) : ∃ P Q : ℂ[X], P.natDegree ≤ m + 1 ∧ Q.natDegree ≤ m + 1 ∧
          ∀ θ : ℝ, (su2Diag (-θ) * simpChainCross R₀ Rs c₀ stepC_init θ * (su2Diag (-θ))ᴴ) r s =
            evalConjTrig P Q (2 * θ) := by
        obtain ⟨P₀, Q₀, hP₀, hQ₀, hf₀⟩ := hlaur_ih r s
        fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s
        · exact ⟨P₀, Q₀, hP₀.trans (Nat.le_succ m), hQ₀.trans (Nat.le_succ m),
            fun θ ↦ ((su2Diag_neg_conj_entries θ _).1).trans (hf₀ θ)⟩
        · obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hmul⟩ := evalConjTrig_mul_z ⟨P₀, Q₀, hP₀, hQ₀, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
          exact ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, fun θ ↦ ((su2Diag_neg_conj_entries θ _).2.2.1).trans
            ((congrArg (_ * ·) (hf₀ θ)).trans (hmul (2 * θ)))⟩
        · obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hmul⟩ := evalConjTrig_mul_conj_z ⟨P₀, Q₀, hP₀, hQ₀, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
          exact ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, fun θ ↦ ((su2Diag_neg_conj_entries θ _).2.2.2).trans
            ((congrArg (_ * ·) (hf₀ θ)).trans (hmul (2 * θ)))⟩
        · exact ⟨P₀, Q₀, hP₀.trans (Nat.le_succ m), hQ₀.trans (Nat.le_succ m),
            fun θ ↦ ((su2Diag_neg_conj_entries θ _).2.1).trans (hf₀ θ)⟩
      intro r s
      obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, hf⟩ := evalConjTrig_mat_mul_left_right U_top Rᴴ _ hmid r s
      exact ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, fun θ ↦ (congrArg (fun M ↦ M r s) (hrec θ)).trans (hf θ)⟩

/-- One-sided Taylor bound with the sharp `1 / 2` factor around a critical point `deriv f a = 0`. -/
theorem sub_le_half_sq_of_deriv_eq_zero_and_deriv2_le {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf' : Differentiable ℝ (deriv f))
    {a : ℝ} (ha : deriv f a = 0) {K : ℝ} (_hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (h2 : ∀ x : ℝ, |deriv (deriv f) x| ≤ K) (b : ℝ) :
    f a - f b ≤ (K / 2) * (a - b) ^ 2 := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦ f a - f x - (K / 2) * (x - a) ^ 2
  have hg_deriv (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt g (-deriv f x - K * (x - a)) x :=
    (((hasDerivAt_const x (f a)).sub (hf x).hasDerivAt).congr_deriv (by ring)).sub
      (((((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const a).pow 2).const_mul (K / 2)).congr_deriv (by ring))
  have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := fun x ↦ (hg_deriv x).differentiableAt
  have hmvt {u : ℝ → ℝ} (hu : Differentiable ℝ u) {x y : ℝ} (h : x < y) :
      ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo x y, u y - u x = deriv u c * (y - x) :=
    let ⟨c, hc, hs⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope u h hu.continuous.continuousOn hu.differentiableOn
    ⟨c, hc, ((eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr h.ne')).mp hs).symm⟩
  suffices hgb : g b ≤ 0 by
    linarith [show g b = f a - f b - (K / 2) * (a - b) ^ 2 by dsimp [g]; ring]
  have hga : g a = 0 := by dsimp only [g]; ring
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hab | rfl | hba
  · obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, hgb⟩ := hmvt hg_diff hab
    obtain ⟨c₂, _, hdf⟩ := hmvt hf' hc₁.1
    linarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by
      rw [(hg_deriv c₁).deriv]
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_le.mp (h2 c₂)).1 (sub_pos.mpr hc₁.1).le] :
      deriv g c₁ ≤ 0) (sub_pos.mpr hab).le]
  · exact hga.le
  · obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, hgb⟩ := hmvt hg_diff hba
    obtain ⟨c₂, _, hdf⟩ := hmvt hf' hc₁.2
    linarith [mul_nonneg (by
      rw [(hg_deriv c₁).deriv]
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_le.mp (h2 c₂)).1 (sub_pos.mpr hc₁.2).le] :
      0 ≤ deriv g c₁) (sub_pos.mpr hba).le]
noncomputable def poly11 (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    1 - y + y ^ 2 / 2 - y ^ 3 / 6 + y ^ 4 / 24 - y ^ 5 / 120 + y ^ 6 / 720 - y ^ 7 / 5040 + y ^ 8 /
    40320 - y ^ 9 / 362880 + y ^ 10 / 3628800 - y ^ 11 / 39916800
noncomputable def poly11Deriv (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    -1 + y - y ^ 2 / 2 + y ^ 3 / 6 - y ^ 4 / 24 + y ^ 5 / 120 - y ^ 6 / 720 + y ^ 7 / 5040 - y ^ 8 /
    40320 + y ^ 9 / 362880 - y ^ 10 / 3628800
theorem hasDerivAt_poly11 (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt poly11 (poly11Deriv t) t := by
  unfold poly11
  refine ((((((((((((hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id' t)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).div_const 2)).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 3 t).div_const 6)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_pow 4 t).div_const 24)).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 5 t).div_const 120)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_pow 6 t).div_const 720)).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 7 t).div_const 5040)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_pow 8 t).div_const 40320)).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 9 t).div_const 362880)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_pow 10 t).div_const 3628800)).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_pow 11 t).div_const 39916800)).congr_deriv ?_
  unfold poly11Deriv
  ring

theorem poly11_le_exp_neg {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) : poly11 y ≤ Real.exp (-y) := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hy with rfl | hy_pos
  · simp [poly11]
  · let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ Real.exp t * poly11 t
    have hg_deriv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt g (Real.exp t * (-t ^ 11 / 39916800)) t :=
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp t).mul (hasDerivAt_poly11 t)).congr_deriv (by
        unfold poly11 poly11Deriv; ring)
    have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := fun t ↦ (hg_deriv t).differentiableAt
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hslope⟩ :=
      exists_deriv_eq_slope g hy_pos hg_diff.continuous.continuousOn hg_diff.differentiableOn
    have hgy_le : g y ≤ 1 := by
      have hdc : deriv g c ≤ 0 := (hg_deriv c).deriv ▸ by
        have := hc.1.le
        nlinarith [show 0 ≤ c ^ 11 / 39916800 by positivity, (Real.exp_pos c).le]
      linarith [((eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hy_pos.ne')).mp hslope).symm,
        show g 0 = 1 by simp [g, poly11], mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hdc hy_pos.le]
    simpa only [g, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, mul_one]
      using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgy_le (Real.exp_pos (-y)).le

def dist16Num (b : Fin 8) (s : Fin 28) : ℕ :=
    if s.val ≤ 13 then 16 * (13 - s.val) + b.val + 1 else 16 * (s.val - 13) - b.val
def yUbNum6 (b : Fin 8) (s : Fin 28) : ℕ :=
  let d16 := dist16Num b s
  let B := 256 * 10 ^ 23
  (193565278 * 3141592654 ^ 2 * d16 ^ 2 + (B - 1)) / B

def poly11ExactNum (n : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  let D : ℤ := 1000000
  39916800 * D ^ 11
  - 39916800 * n * D ^ 10
  + 19958400 * n ^ 2 * D ^ 9
  - 6652800 * n ^ 3 * D ^ 8
  + 1663200 * n ^ 4 * D ^ 7
  - 332640 * n ^ 5 * D ^ 6
  + 55440 * n ^ 6 * D ^ 5
  - 7920 * n ^ 7 * D ^ 4
  + 990 * n ^ 8 * D ^ 3

  + 11 * n ^ 10 * D

theorem poly11ExactNum_eq (n : ℤ) : ((poly11ExactNum n : ℤ) : ℝ) / (39916800 * (1000000 : ℝ) ^ 11) =
    poly11 ((n : ℝ) / 1000000) := by unfold poly11ExactNum poly11; push_cast; ring
abbrev checkLaplaceBin6 (b : Fin 8) : Prop :=
    12602946493654 * 39916800 * (1000000 : ℤ) ^ 9 ≤ ∑ s : Fin 28, poly11ExactNum (yUbNum6 b s : ℤ)
theorem checkLaplaceBin6_all : ∀ b : Fin 8, checkLaplaceBin6 b := by decide +kernel
theorem nat_le_ceil_div_mul (a B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) : a ≤ ((a + (B - 1)) / B) * B := by
  have hdiv : ((a + (B - 1)) / B) * B + (a + (B - 1)) % B = a + (B - 1) := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_add_mod (a + (B - 1)) B
  have hmod : (a + (B - 1)) % B < B := Nat.mod_lt (a + (B - 1)) hB; omega
theorem y_exact_le_yUbNum6 (b : Fin 8) (s : Fin 28) : (193565278 / 10 ^ 7 : ℝ) *
    ((3141592654 / 10 ^ 9 : ℝ) ^ 2 / 10000) * (((dist16Num b s : ℕ) : ℝ) / 16) ^ 2 ≤
    ((yUbNum6 b s : ℕ) : ℝ) / 1000000 := by
  have hB : 0 < 256 * 10 ^ 23 := by positivity
  have hnat :=
      nat_le_ceil_div_mul (193565278 * 3141592654 ^ 2 * (dist16Num b s) ^ 2) (256 * 10 ^ 23) hB
  have hcast : ((193565278 * 3141592654 ^ 2 * (dist16Num b s) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (((yUbNum6 b s) * (256 * 10 ^ 23) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
  push_cast at hcast; linarith
theorem dist16Num_le_224 (b : Fin 8) (s : Fin 28) : dist16Num b s ≤ 224 := by
  unfold dist16Num; have hb := b.isLt; have hs := s.isLt
  split_ifs <;> omega

theorem cluster28_sum_ge_s_lb (b : Fin 8) : (12602946493654 / 10 ^ 12 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ s : Fin 28,
    Real.exp (-((193565278 / 10 ^ 7 : ℝ) * ((3141592654 / 10 ^ 9 : ℝ) ^ 2 / 10000) *
    (((dist16Num b s : ℕ) : ℝ) / 16) ^ 2)) := by
  have hcast : ((12602946493654 * 39916800 * (1000000 : ℤ) ^ 9 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((∑ s : Fin 28, poly11ExactNum (yUbNum6 b s : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) :=

    (hRest : SubspaceStep (mkKetOpW rWork st ph) R_out rest) : SubspaceStep (mkKetOpW rWork (fun δ ↦
    Function.update (st δ) q (st δ c₁ * st δ c₂)) ph) R_out (xUnloadCzPairsSeqDyn v q [⟨c₁,
    ⟨c₂, hc12⟩⟩] rest) := by
  let f : BitAssignment n → ZMod 2 := fun β ↦ β c₁ * β c₂
  have hf : ∀ β a, f (Function.update β q a) = f β := fun β a ↦ by
    dsimp only [f]; rw [Function.update_of_ne hqc1, Function.update_of_ne hqc2]
  have hf_eq : ∀ β, f β = czPairsParity [⟨c₁, ⟨c₂, hc12⟩⟩] β := fun β ↦ by
    dsimp only [f, czPairsParity]; rw [add_zero]
  have hOpEq : (xorWireUnitary q f hf).1 * mkKetOpW rWork st ph = mkKetOpW rWork (fun δ ↦
      Function.update (st δ) q (st δ c₁ * st δ c₂)) ph := by
    apply matrix_ext_ket; intro δ
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, mkKetOpW_mulVec_ket, mkKetOpW_mulVec_ket]
    split_ifs with hz
    · rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, xorWireUnitary_mulVec_ket, hq0 δ hz, zero_add]
    · rw [Matrix.mulVec_zero]
  exact subspaceStep_congr_in hOpEq.symm (subspaceStep_xUnloadCzPairsSeqDyn v q [⟨c₁,
      ⟨c₂,
      hc12⟩⟩] rest f hf hf_eq (mkKetOpW rWork st ph) R_out (projBit_zero_mkKetOpW rWork q st ph hq0)
      hRest)

theorem zmod2_cases (x : ZMod 2) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 :=
  match x with | ⟨0, _⟩ => Or.inl rfl | ⟨1, _⟩ => Or.inr rfl

theorem update_writeReg_reg {m n : ℕ} (β : BitAssignment n) (r : QRegister m n) (f : Fin m → ZMod 2)
    (i : Fin m) (val : ZMod 2) : Function.update (writeReg β r f)
    (r i) val = writeReg β r (Function.update f i val) := by
  funext w
  by_cases hm : ∃ j : Fin m, r j = w
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hm
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · subst hij; rw [Function.update_self, writeReg_apply_reg, Function.update_self]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun h ↦ hij (r.wires.injective h)), writeReg_apply_reg,
          writeReg_apply_reg, Function.update_of_ne hij]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun h ↦ hm ⟨i, h.symm⟩), writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hm,
        writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hm]

theorem ket_X_writeReg {m n : ℕ} (r : QRegister m n) (i : Fin m) (β : BitAssignment n)
    (f : Fin m → ZMod 2) : (Circuit.X (r i)).eval.1.mulVec (ket (writeReg β r f)) =
    ket (writeReg β r (Function.update f i (f i + 1))) := by
  rw [ket_X, writeReg_apply_reg, update_writeReg_reg]
theorem ket_CNOT_writeReg {m n : ℕ} (r : QRegister m n) (c t : Fin m) (hct : c ≠ t)
    (β : BitAssignment n) (f : Fin m → ZMod 2) : (Circuit.CNOT (r c) (r t)
    (fun h ↦ hct (r.wires.injective h))).eval.1.mulVec (ket (writeReg β r f)) =
    ket (writeReg β r (Function.update f t (f t + f c))) := by
  rw [ket_CNOT, writeReg_apply_reg, writeReg_apply_reg, update_writeReg_reg]
theorem writeReg_self_local {m n : ℕ} (β : BitAssignment n) (r : QRegister m n) :
    writeReg β r (fun i ↦ β (r i)) = β := by
  funext w
  by_cases hm : ∃ i : Fin m, r i = w
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hm; exact writeReg_apply_reg β r _ i
  · exact writeReg_apply_of_not_mem β r _ w hm

theorem cw_andComputeCircuit {n : ℕ} {S : Wire n → Prop} (c₁ c₂ anc : Wire n) (h₁₂ : c₁ ≠ c₂)
    (h₁a : c₁ ≠ anc) (h₂a : c₂ ≠ anc) (hc1 : S c₁) (hc2 : S c₂)
    (ha : S anc) : CircWires S (andComputeCircuit c₁ c₂ anc h₁₂ h₁a h₂a) := by
  have hInv : CircWires S ((Circuit.T anc).inverse) := by
    dsimp [Circuit.T, Circuit.S, Circuit.H, Circuit.Z, Circuit.X, Circuit.inverse,
        Circuit.inverseGate, CircWires]
    repeat (first | constructor | (intro i; fin_cases i; exact ha))
  unfold andComputeCircuit;
  exact ⟨cw_1 ha, cw_1 ha, cw_cnot hc2 ha, hInv, cw_cnot hc1 ha, cw_1 ha, cw_cnot hc2 ha, hInv,
      cw_cnot hc1 ha, cw_1 ha, cw_1 ha⟩
def muxWorkValNoM2 {Wp n : ℕ} (_h193 : 193 ≤ Wp) (isCsel : Bool) (r41 : QRegister (122 + Wp) n)
    (m0 : ℕ) (β : BitAssignment n) (u : Fin Wp) : ZMod 2 :=
  let wt := Wtop Wp isCsel
  if isCsel && decide (u.val = Wp - 1) then
    β (wPotBLocQ r41) * β (wPotBIsPot r41)
  else if wt - 48 + m0 ≤ u.val ∧ u.val < wt - 24 then
    if β (wPotBIsNN r41) == 1 then
      β (rPotBNucA r41 ⟨(u.val - (wt - 48)) % 24, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩)
    else
      β (rPotBElecA r41 ⟨(u.val - (wt - 48)) % 24, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩)
  else 0

theorem muxStNoM2_pool_zero {Wp n : ℕ} (h193 : 193 ≤ Wp) (isCsel : Bool)

    (hNoGate : isCsel = false ∨ u ≠ Wp - 1)

theorem muxStNoM2_240_zero {Wp n : ℕ} (h193 : 193 ≤ Wp) (isCsel : Bool)

theorem muxStNoM2_gate_true {Wp n : ℕ} (h193 : 193 ≤ Wp)
    (r41 : QRegister (122 + Wp) n) (m0 : ℕ)
    (z16 : Fin 16 → ZMod 2) (β : BitAssignment n) :

      if potBGateActive true r41 β then 1 else 0 := by

    congrArg r41.wires (Fin.ext (by dsimp only; omega))
  rw [hwEq, muxStNoM2_r122 h193 true r41 m0 z16 β ⟨Wp - 1, by omega⟩]

theorem muxStNoM2_m1 {Wp n : ℕ} (h193 : 193 ≤ Wp) (isCsel : Bool) (r41 : QRegister (122 + Wp) n)
    (m0 : ℕ) (z16 : Fin 16 → ZMod 2) (β : BitAssignment n)
    (i : Fin 24) : muxStNoM2 h193 isCsel r41 m0 z16 β (rMuxM1 h193 isCsel r41 i) = if m0 ≤
    i.val then (if β (wPotBIsNN r41) == 1 then β (rPotBNucA r41 i) else β (rPotBElecA r41 i)) else 0
    := by
  have hw := wtop_ge192 h193 isCsel; have hwle := wtop_le_wp Wp isCsel;
  let u0 : ℕ := Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val
  have heq : rMuxM1 h193 isCsel r41 i = r41 ⟨122 + u0, by omega⟩ :=
    congrArg r41.wires (Fin.ext (by simp only [QRegister.block_apply_val, u0]; omega))
  rw [heq, muxStNoM2_r122 h193 isCsel r41 m0 z16 β ⟨u0, by omega⟩]
  unfold muxWorkValNoM2; dsimp only [u0]
  have hc1 : (isCsel && decide (Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val = Wp - 1)) = false := by
    cases isCsel <;> simp only [Wtop, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_and, Bool.true_and,
        decide_eq_false_iff_not]
    have := i.isLt; omega
  simp only [hc1, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  by_cases hm : m0 ≤ i.val
  · have hc3 : Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + m0 ≤ Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val ∧
        Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val < Wtop Wp isCsel - 24 := ⟨by omega, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
    have hiEq : (⟨(Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val - (Wtop Wp isCsel - 48)) % 24,
        Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ : Fin 24) = i :=
      Fin.ext
          (by dsimp; rw [show Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val - (Wtop Wp isCsel - 48) = i.val by omega,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.isLt])
    simp only [hm, hc3, and_self, ↓reduceIte, hiEq]
  · have hc3 : ¬(Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + m0 ≤ Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val ∧
        Wtop Wp isCsel - 48 + i.val < Wtop Wp isCsel - 24) := by omega
    simp only [hm, hc3, ↓reduceIte]

theorem outer_wrappers_noM2 {Wp M n : ℕ} (h193 : 193 ≤ Wp) (isCsel : Bool) (hM : M ≤ 24)
    (r41 : QRegister (122 + Wp) n) (z16 : Fin 16 → ZMod 2)
    {β : BitAssignment n} (hWk : ∀ u : Fin Wp, β (rPotBWork r41 u) = 0) :
    let stZ := writeReg β (rMuxZ16 r41) z16
    let stG := gateWrapMux h193 isCsel r41 stZ
    writeSub24 stG (rMuxM1 h193 isCsel r41) M (24 - M) (mux1DistBit r41 stG) =
    muxStNoM2 h193 isCsel r41 M z16 β := by
  have hw := wtop_ge192 h193 isCsel
  have hwle := wtop_le_wp Wp isCsel
  dsimp only
  set stZ := writeReg β (rMuxZ16 r41) z16
  set stG := gateWrapMux h193 isCsel r41 stZ
  have hG_ne : ∀ {w : Wire n}, (isCsel = true → w ≠ r41 ⟨122 + Wp - 1, by omega⟩) → stG w = stZ w :=
      fun hwne ↦ by
    unfold stG gateWrapMux
    cases isCsel <;> simp only [↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true]
    exact Function.update_of_ne (hwne rfl) _ _
  have hZ_lt106 : ∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : m < 106), stZ (r41 ⟨m, by omega⟩) = β (r41 ⟨m, by omega⟩) :=
    fun hm ↦ writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ r41_blk_ne_wire r41 j _ (by omega) hj)
  have hG_lt106 : ∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : m < 106), stG (r41 ⟨m, by omega⟩) = β (r41 ⟨m, by omega⟩) :=
    fun hm ↦ (hG_ne fun _ ↦ r41_ne r41 _ _ (by omega)).trans (hZ_lt106 hm)
  have hZ_wk : ∀ u : Fin Wp, stZ (rPotBWork r41 u) = 0 := fun u ↦
    (writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦
        r41_blk_ne_blk r41 j u (by omega) hj)).trans (hWk u)
  have hBitM1 : ∀ i : Fin 24, mux1DistBit r41 stG i =
      if β (wPotBIsNN r41) == 1 then β (rPotBNucA r41 i) else β (rPotBElecA r41 i) := fun i ↦ by
    unfold mux1DistBit
    rw [show wPotBIsNN r41 = r41 ⟨4, by omega⟩ from rfl,
        show rPotBNucA r41 i = r41 ⟨9 + i.val,
            by omega⟩ from congrArg r41.wires (Fin.ext (by simp only [QRegister.block_apply_val])),
        show rPotBElecA r41 i = r41 ⟨33 + i.val,

      (if j.val.testBit 2 then (b2 == 1) else !(b2 == 1))) := by
  revert j b0 b1 b2
  decide +kernel

theorem unld_idxVal3_lt6_fin (b0 b1 b2 : ZMod 2) (hDisj : ((b1 == 1) && (b2 == 1)) = false) :
    (((0 + if b0 = 1 then 2 ^ 0 else 0) + if b1 = 1 then 2 ^ 1 else 0) +
      if b2 = 1 then 2 ^ 2 else 0) < 6 := by
  revert b0 b1 b2 hDisj
  decide +kernel

/-- Minterm column accumulator for `D`-bit `WRouter` one-hot outputs on `0 .. 2^10 - 1`. -/
def unldMintermCol (m10 idxBase j : ℕ) (ct : CT) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => m10
  | d + 1 =>
      let cd := getCT 7 ct (idxBase + d)
      syncNat (unldMintermCol m10 idxBase j ct d &&& (if j.testBit d then cd else m10 ^^^ cd))

def unldOhColsD (D N idxBase : ℕ) (ct : CT) : List ℕ :=
  (List.range N).map (fun j ↦ unldMintermCol (coordState 10).2.1 idxBase j ct D)

def unldRouterPre (rk : UnldRKind) (idxBase outBase : ℕ) (ct : CT) : Bool :=
  let m10 := (coordState 10).2.1
  decide (11 ≤ idxBase ∧ idxBase + rk.dim ≤ outBase ∧ outBase + rk.nOut ≤ 80) &&
  Nat.beq (getCT 7 ct 10) m10 &&
  (List.range rk.nOut).all (fun j ↦ Nat.beq (getCT 7 ct (outBase + j)) 0) &&
  match rk with
  | .p2_1 | .p2_2 => true
  | .r3_1 => Nat.beq (getCT 7 ct (idxBase + 1) &&& getCT 7 ct (idxBase + 2)) 0

/-- Single-stage `CT` transition loading `s.ohCols` onto `evalStrict` output. -/
def unldEvalStageCT (s : UnldStage) (ct : CT) : CT :=
  loadCols s.rk.nOut s.outBase s.ohCols (evalStrict 79 (coordState 10).2.1 ct s.tree)

def unldCheckCols (n : ℕ) (cols : List ℕ) (ct : CT) : Bool :=
  (List.range n).all (fun u ↦ Nat.beq (cols.getD u 0) (getCT 7 ct u))

def unldCheckStageMid (s : UnldStage) (ct ctMid : CT) (rest : CT → Bool) : Bool :=
  let chk := checkPrimTree 79 0 s.sMask s.tree
  let okSM := (List.range 80).all (fun u ↦ !(s.sMask.testBit u) || Nat.beq (getCT 7 ct u) 0)
  let okOh := (List.range s.rk.nOut).all (fun j ↦
    Nat.beq (s.ohCols.getD j 0) (unldMintermCol (coordState 10).2.1 s.idxBase j ctMid s.rk.dim))
  chk.1 && Nat.beq chk.2.2 s.nAnd && okSM && unldRouterPre s.rk s.idxBase s.outBase ctMid &&
    okOh && rest (loadCols s.rk.nOut s.outBase s.ohCols ctMid)

def unldEvalStagesCT : List UnldStage → CT → CT
  | [], ct => ct
  | s :: ss, ct => unldEvalStagesCT ss (unldEvalStageCT s ct)

def unldCheckStagesAndOut (out80 : List ℕ) : List UnldStage → CT → Bool
  | [], ct => unldCheckCols 80 out80 ct
  | s :: ss, ct =>
      unldCheckStageMid s ct (evalStrict 79 (coordState 10).2.1 ct s.tree)
        (unldCheckStagesAndOut out80 ss)

theorem unldCheckStagesAndOut_outCols (out80 : List ℕ) :
    ∀ (ss : List UnldStage) (ct : CT),
      unldCheckStagesAndOut out80 ss ct = true →
      unldCheckCols 80 out80 (unldEvalStagesCT ss ct) = true
  | [], _, h => h
  | s :: ss, ct, h => by
      dsimp only [unldCheckStagesAndOut, unldCheckStageMid, unldEvalStagesCT,
          unldEvalStageCT] at h ⊢
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      exact unldCheckStagesAndOut_outCols out80 ss _ h.2

def unldFoldStagesProg {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} (v : Var) (r : QRegister (10 + 30 + 71) n) :
    List UnldStage → DynamicCircuit Var n → DynamicCircuit Var n
  | [], pLeaf => pLeaf
  | s :: ss, pLeaf =>
      let rAllScr := rUnldAllScr r
      wrapDynOnReg v rAllScr (decodePrimTree 79 s.tree)
        (s.rk.bracket.wrap v (wUnldHas r)
          (wUnldIdxMod s.rk.dim rAllScr s.idxBase)
          (wUnldOutMod rAllScr s.outBase s.rk.nOut) (wUnldQEnc r)
          (unldFoldStagesProg v r ss pLeaf))

def unldStagesT : List UnldStage → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | s :: ss => 4 * s.nAnd + (s.rk.tCost + unldStagesT ss)

theorem unld_dynWires_stages {Var : Type} {n : ℕ} {S : Wire n → Prop}
    (v : Var) (r : QRegister (10 + 30 + 71) n)
    (hrScr : ∀ u : Fin 80, S (rUnldAllScr r u)) (hrQ : S (wUnldQEnc r))
    (ss : List UnldStage) {pLeaf : DynamicCircuit Var n}
    (hLeaf : DynWires S pLeaf) : DynWires S (unldFoldStagesProg v r ss pLeaf) :=
  match ss with
  | [] => hLeaf
  | s :: ss =>
      dynWires_wrapDynOnReg v (rUnldAllScr r) hrScr (decodePrimTree 79 s.tree)
        (s.rk.bracket.dynWires_wrap v _ _ _ (wUnldQEnc r) _
          (hrScr ⟨10, by decide⟩) (fun _ ↦ hrScr _) (fun _ ↦ hrScr _) hrQ
          (unld_dynWires_stages v r hrScr hrQ ss hLeaf))

theorem unld_coord10_bit {idx : ℕ} (hIdx : idx < 2 ^ 10) :
    (coordState 10).2.1.testBit idx = true := by
  obtain ⟨_, hC10, _, _, _⟩ := coordState_spec 10
  rw [hC10, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one]
  exact decide_eq_true (hIdx.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by norm_num)))

theorem unld_step_prim80 {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {W n nAnd tNext : ℕ}
    [NeZero (2 ^ n)] (v : Var) {ct : CT} {rWork : QRegister W n}
    {r : QRegister (10 + 30 + 71) n} {idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ} (hIdxLt : ∀ δ, idxOf δ < 2 ^ 10)
    {g : BitAssignment n → Fin 30 → ZMod 2}
    {st stWB : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n} {ph : BitAssignment n → ZMod 2}
    (sMask : ℕ) (tree : PrimTree)
    (hTreeOk : (checkPrimTree 79 0 sMask tree).1 = true)
    (hAndEq : (checkPrimTree 79 0 sMask tree).2.2 = nAnd)
    (hSM : (List.range 80).all (fun u ↦ !(sMask.testBit u) || Nat.beq (getCT 7 ct u) 0) = true)
    (inv : UnldScrInv ct rWork r idxOf g st stWB)
    (pNext : DynamicCircuit Var n)
    (hNext : ∀ stM stWBM,
      UnldScrInv (evalStrict 79 (coordState 10).2.1 ct tree) rWork r idxOf g stM stWBM →
      SubspaceStep (Var := Var) (mkKetOpW rWork stWBM ph) (mkKetOpW rWork stM ph) pNext ∧
      pNext.count .T = tNext ∧ pNext.count .TOFF = 0) :
    SubspaceStep (Var := Var) (mkKetOpW rWork stWB ph) (mkKetOpW rWork st ph)
      (wrapDynOnReg v (rUnldAllScr r) (decodePrimTree 79 tree) pNext) ∧
    (wrapDynOnReg v (rUnldAllScr r) (decodePrimTree 79 tree) pNext).count .T = 4 * nAnd + tNext ∧
    (wrapDynOnReg v (rUnldAllScr r) (decodePrimTree 79 tree) pNext).count .TOFF = 0 := by
  let rAllScr := rUnldAllScr r
  let hDisj := rUnldAllScr_disj_idOut r
  let cp : ComputeProg 80 := decodePrimTree 79 tree
  have hInvMid : UnldScrInv (evalStrict 79 (coordState 10).2.1 ct tree) rWork r idxOf g
      (fun δ ↦ stepCB rAllScr cp.fwdBits (st δ)) (fun δ ↦ stepCB rAllScr cp.fwdBits (stWB δ)) :=
    ⟨fun δ hz u ↦ by
      dsimp only [stepCB]
      rw [writeReg_apply_reg]
      set β : Fin 80 → ZMod 2 := fun v' ↦ st δ (rAllScr v')
      exact (fwdBits_decodePrimTree_testBit tree β (natOfZModBits 80 β)
        (fun v' ↦ (natOfZModBits_testBit_lt β v'.isLt).symm) u).trans
        (evalStrict_sound (by decide : 79 < 128) tree ct (natOfZModBits 80 β) (idxOf δ)
            (unld_coord10_bit (hIdxLt δ))
          (fun v' hv' ↦ ((natOfZModBits_testBit_lt β hv').trans (inv.scr_col δ hz ⟨v',
              hv'⟩)).symm) u.val u.isLt).symm,
     fun δ hz ↦
         (writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨u, hu⟩ ↦
         rUnldAllScr_ne_qEnc r u hu)).trans (inv.q_zero δ hz),
     fun δ hz j ↦
         (writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨u, hu⟩ ↦
         disj_ne hDisj u j hu)).trans (inv.out_zero δ hz j),
     fun δ hz ↦ by rw [inv.wb_eq δ hz, stepCB_writeReg_comm rAllScr (rUnldIdOut r) hDisj]⟩
  obtain ⟨hStepM, htM, hfM⟩ := hNext _ _ hInvMid
  rcases decodePrimTree_spec 79 tree 0 sMask with ⟨hv, _, ha⟩
  have hScr0 (u : Wire 80) (hu : u ∈ maskFinset 80 sMask) (δ)
      (hz : ∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) : st δ (rAllScr u) = 0 := by
    have h0 : getCT 7 ct u.val = 0 := Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true (by
      simpa [mem_maskFinset.mp hu] using List.all_eq_true.mp hSM u.val (List.mem_range.mpr u.isLt))
    exact zmod2_eq_ite_of_beq_one _ false
      ((inv.scr_col δ hz u).trans (by rw [h0, Nat.zero_testBit]))
  obtain ⟨hWrap, htW, hfW, _⟩ := subspaceStep_wrapOnReg_vprog2 v rWork rAllScr
    (maskFinset 80 sMask) cp nAnd
    (maskFinset_zero 80 ▸ StructuredCB.validProg_of_validProgMask (hv.trans hTreeOk))
    (ha.trans hAndEq) stWB st ph ph pNext (fun u hu δ hz ↦ by
      rw [inv.wb_eq δ hz,
        writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ disj_ne hDisj u j hj.symm)]
      exact hScr0 u hu δ hz) hScr0 hStepM
  exact ⟨hWrap, htW.trans (congrArg (4 * nAnd + ·) htM), hfW.trans hfM⟩

theorem unld_step_wrouter {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {W n tNext : ℕ}
    (v : Var) {ct : CT} {rWork : QRegister W n}
    {r : QRegister (10 + 30 + 71) n} {idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ} (hIdxLt : ∀ δ, idxOf δ < 2 ^ 10)
    {g : BitAssignment n → Fin 30 → ZMod 2}
    {st stWB : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n} {ph : BitAssignment n → ZMod 2}
    (rk : UnldRKind) (idxBase outBase : ℕ)
    (hRChk : unldRouterPre rk idxBase outBase ct = true)
    (inv : UnldScrInv ct rWork r idxOf g st stWB)
    (pNext : DynamicCircuit Var n)
    (hNext : ∀ stR stWBR,
      UnldScrInv (loadCols rk.nOut outBase (unldOhColsD rk.dim rk.nOut idxBase ct) ct)
        rWork r idxOf g stR stWBR →
      SubspaceStep (Var := Var) (mkKetOpW rWork stWBR ph) (mkKetOpW rWork stR ph) pNext ∧
      pNext.count .T = tNext ∧ pNext.count .TOFF = 0) :
    SubspaceStep (Var := Var) (mkKetOpW rWork stWB ph) (mkKetOpW rWork st ph)
      (rk.bracket.wrap v (wUnldHas r) (wUnldIdxMod rk.dim (rUnldAllScr r) idxBase)
        (wUnldOutMod (rUnldAllScr r) outBase rk.nOut) (wUnldQEnc r) pNext) ∧
    (rk.bracket.wrap v (wUnldHas r) (wUnldIdxMod rk.dim (rUnldAllScr r) idxBase)
      (wUnldOutMod (rUnldAllScr r) outBase rk.nOut) (wUnldQEnc r) pNext).count .T = rk.tCost +
          tNext ∧
    (rk.bracket.wrap v (wUnldHas r) (wUnldIdxMod rk.dim (rUnldAllScr r) idxBase)
      (wUnldOutMod (rUnldAllScr r) outBase rk.nOut) (wUnldQEnc r) pNext).count .TOFF = 0 := by
  let rAllScr := rUnldAllScr r
  let hDisj := rUnldAllScr_disj_idOut r
  let wIdx := wUnldIdxMod rk.dim rAllScr idxBase
  let wOut := wUnldOutMod rAllScr outBase rk.nOut
  dsimp only [unldRouterPre] at hRChk
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hRChk
  rcases hRChk with ⟨⟨⟨hBndDec, hHasBeq⟩, hOutAll⟩, hTopChk⟩
  have hBnd : 11 ≤ idxBase ∧ idxBase + rk.dim ≤ outBase ∧ outBase + rk.nOut ≤ 80 :=
      of_decide_eq_true hBndDec
  let hd :=
      wRouterDisj_unld rk.dim rAllScr (wUnldQEnc r)
      (rUnldAllScr_ne_qEnc r) idxBase outBase rk.nOut hBnd
  have hzCol : ∀ j < rk.nOut, getCT 7 ct (outBase + j) = 0 := fun j hj ↦
    Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true ((List.all_eq_true.mp hOutAll) j (List.mem_range.mpr hj))
  have hWB_scr : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → ∀ u : Fin 80, stWB δ (rAllScr u) =
      st δ (rAllScr u) :=
    fun δ hz u ↦ (congrFun (inv.wb_eq δ hz) _).trans
      (writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨s, hs⟩ ↦ disj_ne hDisj u s hs.symm))
  have hHas1 : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → st δ (wUnldHas r) = 1 := fun δ hz ↦ by
    have hc := inv.scr_col δ hz ⟨10, by decide⟩
    rw [Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true hHasBeq, unld_coord10_bit (hIdxLt δ)] at hc
    exact zmod2_eq_ite_of_beq_one _ true hc
  have hHasWB1 : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → stWB δ (wUnldHas r) = 1 :=
    fun δ hz ↦ (hWB_scr δ hz ⟨10, by decide⟩).trans (hHas1 δ hz)
  have hOutEq : ∀ j : Fin rk.nOut, wOut j = rAllScr ⟨outBase + j.val, by omega⟩ :=
    fun j ↦ congrArg rAllScr.wires (Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)))
  have hIdxEqWire : ∀ d : Fin rk.dim, wIdx d = rAllScr ⟨idxBase + d.val, by omega⟩ :=
    fun d ↦ congrArg rAllScr.wires (Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)))
  have hOut0 : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → ∀ j : Fin rk.nOut, st δ (wOut j) = 0 :=
      fun δ hz j ↦ by
    have hc := inv.scr_col δ hz ⟨outBase + j.val, by omega⟩
    rw [hzCol j.val j.isLt, Nat.zero_testBit, ← hOutEq j] at hc
    exact zmod2_eq_ite_of_beq_one _ false hc
  have hOutWB0 : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → ∀ j : Fin rk.nOut, stWB δ (wOut j) = 0 :=
    fun δ hz j ↦ (hWB_scr δ hz _).trans (hOut0 δ hz j)
  have hIdxEq : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → idxValD wIdx (stWB δ) = idxValD wIdx (st δ) :=
    fun δ hz ↦ idxValPrefix_congr wIdx (stWB δ) (st δ) (fun d ↦ hWB_scr δ hz _) rk.dim le_rfl
  have hIdxLtN : ∀ δ, (∀ k : Fin W, δ (rWork k) = 0) → idxValD wIdx (st δ) < rk.nOut := fun δ hz ↦
      by
    cases rk with
    | p2_1 => exact idxValPrefix_lt_two_pow wIdx (st δ) 2 le_rfl
    | p2_2 => exact idxValPrefix_lt_two_pow wIdx (st δ) 3 le_rfl
    | r3_1 =>
      dsimp [UnldRKind.dim, UnldRKind.nOut] at hBnd
      exact unld_idxVal3_lt6_fin (st δ (wIdx ⟨0, by decide⟩))
        (st δ (wIdx ⟨1, by decide⟩)) (st δ (wIdx ⟨2, by decide⟩)) (by
          rw [hIdxEqWire ⟨1, by decide⟩, hIdxEqWire ⟨2, by decide⟩, inv.scr_col δ hz,
            inv.scr_col δ hz, ← Nat.testBit_and, Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true hTopChk, Nat.zero_testBit])
  have hInvR :
      UnldScrInv (loadCols rk.nOut outBase (unldOhColsD rk.dim rk.nOut idxBase ct) ct) rWork r idxOf
      g
      (fun δ ↦ toggleOneHotBits (wUnldHas r) wIdx wOut (st δ))
      (fun δ ↦ toggleOneHotBits (wUnldHas r) wIdx wOut (stWB δ)) := by
    refine ⟨fun δ hz u ↦ ?_, fun δ hz ↦ ?_, fun δ hz s ↦ ?_, fun δ hz ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [getCT_loadCols_on rk.nOut outBase (unldOhColsD rk.dim rk.nOut idxBase ct) ct u.val
          (by omega) (by omega) hzCol]
      by_cases huRange : outBase ≤ u.val ∧ u.val < outBase + rk.nOut
      · simp only [huRange, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
        let j : Fin rk.nOut := ⟨u.val - outBase, by omega⟩
        rw [(congrArg rAllScr.wires (Fin.ext (by dsimp [j]; omega))).trans (hOutEq j).symm,
          toggleOneHotBits_apply_out hd.out_inj (hOut0 δ hz) (hIdxLtN δ hz) j, hHas1 δ hz,
          show (unldOhColsD rk.dim rk.nOut idxBase ct).getD j.val 0 =
            unldMintermCol (coordState 10).2.1 idxBase j.val ct rk.dim by
            simp [unldOhColsD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, j.isLt]]
        have hmBit (d : Fin rk.dim) :
            (if j.val.testBit d.val then getCT 7 ct (idxBase + d.val)
             else (coordState 10).2.1 ^^^ getCT 7 ct (idxBase + d.val)).testBit (idxOf δ) =
              (if j.val.testBit d.val then (st δ (wIdx d) == 1) else !(st δ (wIdx d) == 1)) := by
          have hcd := hIdxEqWire d ▸ inv.scr_col δ hz ⟨idxBase + d.val, by omega⟩
          cases j.val.testBit d.val <;> simp [Nat.testBit_xor, unld_coord10_bit (hIdxLt δ), hcd]
        have hc10 := unld_coord10_bit (hIdxLt δ)
        cases rk with
        | p2_1 =>
          exact (unld_idxVal2_minterm_fin j (st δ (wIdx ⟨0, by decide⟩))
            (st δ (wIdx ⟨1, by decide⟩))).trans (by
            simp only [UnldRKind.dim, unldMintermCol, syncNat_eq, Nat.testBit_and, hc10,
              Bool.true_and, hmBit ⟨0, by decide⟩, hmBit ⟨1, by decide⟩])
        | p2_2 | r3_1 =>
          exact (unld_idxVal3_minterm_fin ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt (by decide)⟩
            (st δ (wIdx ⟨0, by decide⟩)) (st δ (wIdx ⟨1, by decide⟩))
            (st δ (wIdx ⟨2, by decide⟩))).trans (by
            simp only [UnldRKind.dim, unldMintermCol, syncNat_eq, Nat.testBit_and, hc10,
              Bool.true_and, hmBit ⟨0, by decide⟩, hmBit ⟨1, by decide⟩, hmBit ⟨2, by decide⟩])
      · simp only [huRange, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [toggleOneHotBits_apply_other (st δ) fun j e ↦ by
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val (rAllScr.wires.injective (e.trans (hOutEq j)))
          dsimp at hv; omega]
        exact inv.scr_col δ hz u
    · exact (toggleOneHotBits_apply_other (st δ)
          (fun j ↦ (hd.out_ne_q j).symm)).trans (inv.q_zero δ hz)
    · exact (toggleOneHotBits_apply_other (st δ)
        (fun j e ↦ disj_ne hDisj ⟨(outBase + j.val) % 80,
            Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ s e.symm)).trans (inv.out_zero δ hz s)
    · funext w
      by_cases hw : ∃ s : Fin 30, rUnldIdOut r s = w
      · obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hw
        rw [writeReg_apply_reg, toggleOneHotBits_apply_other (stWB δ)
          (fun j e ↦ disj_ne hDisj ⟨(outBase + j.val) % 80, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ s e.symm),
              inv.wb_eq δ hz, writeReg_apply_reg]
      · rw [writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw]
        by_cases hwO : ∃ j : Fin rk.nOut, w = wOut j
        · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hwO
          rw [toggleOneHotBits_apply_out hd.out_inj (hOutWB0 δ hz)
              ((hIdxEq δ hz).symm ▸ hIdxLtN δ hz) j,
            toggleOneHotBits_apply_out hd.out_inj (hOut0 δ hz) (hIdxLtN δ hz) j, hIdxEq δ hz,
                hHasWB1 δ hz, hHas1 δ hz]
        · rw [toggleOneHotBits_apply_other (stWB δ) (fun j e ↦ hwO ⟨j, e⟩),
            toggleOneHotBits_apply_other (st δ) (fun j e ↦ hwO ⟨j, e⟩), inv.wb_eq δ hz,
                writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ hw]
  obtain ⟨hStepR, htR, hfR⟩ := hNext _ _ hInvR
  have hMulToggle : ∀ (stX : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n),
      (uOneHotToggle (wUnldHas r) wIdx wOut hd.has_ne_out hd.idx_ne_out).1 * mkKetOpW rWork stX ph =
        mkKetOpW rWork (fun δ ↦ toggleOneHotBits (wUnldHas r) wIdx wOut (stX δ)) ph := fun stX ↦
    matrix_ext_ket fun δ ↦ by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, mkKetOpW_mulVec_ket, mkKetOpW_mulVec_ket]
      split_ifs with hz
      · rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul, uOneHotToggle_mulVec_ket]
      · rw [Matrix.mulVec_zero]
  obtain ⟨htWrap, hfWrap⟩ := rk.bracket.count_wrap v (wUnldHas r) wIdx wOut (wUnldQEnc r) pNext
  exact ⟨rk.bracket.subspaceStep_wrap v (wUnldHas r) wIdx wOut (wUnldQEnc r) hd pNext
    (mkKetOpW rWork stWB ph) (mkKetOpW rWork st ph)
    (supportedOn_mkKetOpW_unld rWork stWB ph fun δ hz ↦
      ⟨hOutWB0 δ hz, by
        rw [inv.wb_eq δ hz,
          writeReg_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ _ (fun ⟨s, hs⟩ ↦ rUnldIdOut_ne_qEnc r s hs)]
        exact inv.q_zero δ hz,
          (hIdxEq δ hz).symm ▸ hIdxLtN δ hz,
        fun h0 ↦ absurd ((hHasWB1 δ hz).symm.trans h0) one_ne_zero⟩)
    (supportedOn_mkKetOpW_unld rWork st ph fun δ hz ↦
      ⟨hOut0 δ hz, hIdxLtN δ hz, fun h0 ↦ absurd ((hHas1 δ hz).symm.trans h0) one_ne_zero⟩)
    (by rwa [hMulToggle stWB, hMulToggle st]),

theorem unld_step_stages {Var : Type} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {W n tLeaf : ℕ}
    [NeZero (2 ^ n)] (v : Var) {rWork : QRegister W n} {r : QRegister (10 + 30 + 71) n}
    {idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ} (hIdxLt : ∀ δ, idxOf δ < 2 ^ 10)
    {g : BitAssignment n → Fin 30 → ZMod 2} {ph : BitAssignment n → ZMod 2} {out80 : List ℕ} :
    ∀ (ss : List UnldStage) {ct : CT} {st stWB : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n}
      (_hChk : unldCheckStagesAndOut out80 ss ct = true)
      (_inv : UnldScrInv ct rWork r idxOf g st stWB)
      (pLeaf : DynamicCircuit Var n)
      (_hLeaf : ∀ stF stWBF,
        UnldScrInv (unldEvalStagesCT ss ct) rWork r idxOf g stF stWBF →
        SubspaceStep (Var := Var) (mkKetOpW rWork stWBF ph) (mkKetOpW rWork stF ph) pLeaf ∧
        pLeaf.count .T = tLeaf ∧ pLeaf.count .TOFF = 0),
      SubspaceStep (Var := Var) (mkKetOpW rWork stWB ph) (mkKetOpW rWork st ph)
        (unldFoldStagesProg v r ss pLeaf) ∧
      (unldFoldStagesProg v r ss pLeaf).count .T = unldStagesT ss + tLeaf ∧
      (unldFoldStagesProg v r ss pLeaf).count .TOFF = 0
  | [], _, _, _, _, inv, _, hLeaf => by
      dsimp only [unldFoldStagesProg, unldStagesT, unldEvalStagesCT] at *
      rw [Nat.zero_add]
      exact hLeaf _ _ inv
  | s :: ss, ct, st, stWB, hChk, inv, pLeaf, hLeaf => by
      dsimp only [unldCheckStagesAndOut, unldCheckStageMid, unldEvalStagesCT] at hChk hLeaf
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hChk
      rcases hChk with ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hTreeOk, hAndBeq⟩, hSM⟩, hRChk⟩, hOhOk⟩, hChkRest⟩
      set ctMid := evalStrict 79 (coordState 10).2.1 ct s.tree
      have hRPre := hRChk
      simp only [unldRouterPre, Bool.and_eq_true] at hRPre
      have := of_decide_eq_true hRPre.1.1.1
      have hzMid (j) (hj : j < s.rk.nOut) : getCT 7 ctMid (s.outBase + j) = 0 :=
        Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true ((List.all_eq_true.mp hRPre.1.2) j (List.mem_range.mpr hj))
      obtain ⟨hStepS, htS, hfS⟩ := unld_step_prim80 v hIdxLt s.sMask s.tree hTreeOk
        (Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true hAndBeq) hSM inv _ fun stM stWBM hInvM ↦
        unld_step_wrouter v hIdxLt s.rk s.idxBase s.outBase hRChk hInvM _
          fun stR stWBR hInvR ↦ unld_step_stages v hIdxLt ss hChkRest
            (hInvR.congr_ct fun u hu ↦ by
              rw [getCT_loadCols_on s.rk.nOut s.outBase _ ctMid u (by omega) (by omega) hzMid,
                getCT_loadCols_on s.rk.nOut s.outBase _ ctMid u (by omega) (by omega) hzMid]
              split_ifs with hr
              · have hj : u - s.outBase < s.rk.nOut := by omega
                simp only [unldOhColsD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map,
                  List.getElem?_range hj, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
                exact (Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true ((List.all_eq_true.mp hOhOk) _
                  (List.mem_range.mpr hj))).symm
              · rfl) pLeaf hLeaf
      exact ⟨hStepS, by dsimp only [unldFoldStagesProg, unldStagesT]; omega, hfS⟩

/-- Pairwise bottom-up `PrimTree` builder matching exact balanced binary tree parenthesization. -/
def unldPairPrimTrees : List PrimTree → List PrimTree
  | t1 :: t2 :: ts => .node t1 t2 :: unldPairPrimTrees ts
  | ts => ts

def unldMergePrimTrees : ℕ → List PrimTree → PrimTree
  | _, [] => .empty
  | _, [t] => t
  | 0, t :: _ => t
  | k + 1, ts => unldMergePrimTrees k (unldPairPrimTrees ts)

def unldPrimTreeOfLeaves (cs : List ℕ) : PrimTree :=
  unldMergePrimTrees 8 (cs.map PrimTree.leaf)

theorem getCT_unld76CTIn_0 (idx u : ℕ) (hIdx : idx < 2 ^ 10) (hu : u < 128) :
    (getCT 7 unld76CTIn_0 u).testBit idx =
      if u < 10 then idx.testBit u else if u = 10 then true else false := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hLen10, _, htb⟩ := coordState_spec 10
  unfold unld76CTIn_0 unld76InitCols11
  rw [getCT_loadCols 11 0 _ u (by decide) hu]
  by_cases hu10 : u < 10
  · simp only [show 0 ≤ u ∧ u < 0 + 11 by omega, and_self, ↓reduceIte, hu10, Nat.sub_zero,
        List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega), ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    exact htb u hu10 idx hIdx
  · by_cases heq10 : u = 10
    · subst heq10
      simp only [show 0 ≤ 10 ∧ 10 < 0 + 11 by omega, and_self, ↓reduceIte, hu10, Nat.sub_zero,
          List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), hLen10, Nat.sub_self]
      exact unld_coord10_bit hIdx
    · simp [show ¬(u < 11) by omega, hu10, heq10]

    checkQuadMasks 110 30 unld76FullCT110 unld76MaskFn
      unld76ExpPermCols (coordState 10).2.1 = true := by
  unfold unld76FullCT110 unld76ExpPermCols
  decide +kernel

theorem unld76ExpPermCols_testBit_eq {idx idxS : ℕ} (hIdx : idx < 1024) (hs : idxS < 30) :
    (unld76ExpPermCols.getD idxS 0).testBit idx =
      (evalPrimTree 29 (gGatedShr6Word word512DualLeg idx) unld76PreMixTree).testBit idxS := by
  have hMixEq : unld76MixedCols512.getD idxS 0 = getCT 7 unld76MixedOutCT30 idxS :=
    Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true ((List.all_eq_true.mp unld76MixedCols512_chk) idxS (List.mem_range.mpr
        hs))
  rw [show unld76ExpPermCols.getD idxS 0 = (getCT 7 unld76MixedOutCT30 idxS) <<< 512 by
    unfold unld76ExpPermCols
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range hs]
    exact congrArg (· <<< 512) hMixEq]
  unfold unld76MixedOutCT30 gGatedShr6Word
  by_cases h512 : idx < 512
  · simp only [h512, ↓reduceIte, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft, show ¬(512 ≤ idx) by omega,
      decide_false, Bool.false_and, unld76PreMixTree_zero, Nat.zero_testBit]
  · simp only [h512, ↓reduceIte, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft, show 512 ≤ idx by omega, decide_true,
        Bool.true_and]
    obtain ⟨_, hC9, _, _, _⟩ := coordState_spec 9
    refine evalStrict_sound (by decide : 29 < 128) unld76PreMixTree unld76InitOutCT30
      (word512DualLeg (idx - 512) >>> 6) (idx - 512)
      (by rw [hC9, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one, decide_eq_true (by omega)]) (fun v hv ↦ ?_) idxS hs
    unfold unld76InitOutCT30
    rw [getCT_loadCols 30 0 _ v (by decide) (by omega)]
    simp only [show 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 0 + 30 by omega, and_self, ↓reduceIte, Nat.sub_zero]
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range hv]
    dsimp only [Option.map, Option.getD]
    rw [word512DualLeg_testBit_eq_expCols36 (by omega : idx - 512 < 512) (by omega : 6 + v < 36),
        Nat.testBit_shiftRight]

/-- `76-T`, `71`-scratch `WRouter` + quadratic `X`-measurement unload package for dual-leg. -/
def qromUnloadRootG89DualLeg_wrouter_76_unld :
    QromUnloadPkgGenN 10 30 (gGatedShr6Word word512DualLeg) where
  kUnload := 71
  tUnload := 76
  pUnload v r :=
    let pLeaf := pLiveQuadPrimUnload rootG90Live_pos30 .empty unld76MaskFn v
      (rUnldAllScr r) (rUnldIdOut r) (rUnldAllScr_disj_idOut r)
    wrapDynOnReg v (rUnldIdOut r) (decodePrimTree 29 unld76PreMixTree)
      (.seq (.circuit (Circuit.X (wUnldHas r)))
        (.seq (unldFoldStagesProg v r unldStageList pLeaf) (.circuit (Circuit.X (wUnldHas r)))))
  step_and_counts {Var} [Fintype Var] [DecidableEq Var] {W n} [NeZero (2 ^ n)]
      v rWork r st stWB ph hCln hOut hOth := by
    let rOutId := rUnldIdOut r
    let rAllScr := rUnldAllScr r
    let wHas := wUnldHas r
    let hDisj := rUnldAllScr_disj_idOut r
    let rFull := rConcatReg rAllScr rOutId hDisj
    let cpMix : ComputeProg 30 := decodePrimTree 29 unld76PreMixTree
    let idxOf : BitAssignment n → ℕ :=
      fun δ ↦ natOfZModBits 10 (fun i ↦ st δ (r ⟨i.val, idxWire_lt i.isLt⟩))
    have hIdxLt : ∀ δ, idxOf δ < 2 ^ 10 := fun _ ↦ PrimGateEval.natOfZModBits_lt 10 _
    let g : BitAssignment n → Fin 30 → ZMod 2 := fun δ idxS ↦
      if (evalPrimTree 29 (gGatedShr6Word word512DualLeg (idxOf δ)) unld76PreMixTree).testBit
          idxS.val = true then 1 else 0
    let stWBMix : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n := fun δ ↦ stepCB rOutId cpMix.fwdBits (stWB δ)
    let stMix : BitAssignment n → BitAssignment n := fun δ ↦ stepCB rOutId cpMix.fwdBits (st δ)
